author: 海伦·凯勒
quoteCn: 只要我能成为我自己的主人，我便能寻得内心的平静与喜悦。
quoteEn: As long as I am my own, I am happy.

author: 海伦·凯勒
quoteCn: 当灵魂渴望飞翔，又怎能甘于匍匐？那份冲动，是生命最深沉的呐喊。
quoteEn: One can never consent to creep when one feels an impulse to soar.

author: 海伦·凯勒
quoteCn: 万物皆有其奇迹，甚至包括黑暗与寂静。我学会了，无论身处何种境地，都能从中找到那份安然与自足。
quoteEn: Everything has its wonders, even darkness and silence, and I learn, whatever state I may be in, therein to be content.

author: 海伦·凯勒
quoteCn: 信念，是那股让支离破碎的世界，最终能挣扎着，向光而生的力量。
quoteEn: Faith is the strength by which a shattered world shall emerge into the light.

author: 亨利·扬曼
quoteCn: 当我读到饮酒的种种弊端，我便毅然决然地，戒掉了阅读。
quoteEn: When I read about the evils of drinking, I gave up reading.

author: 海伦·凯勒
quoteCn: 对我而言，这世界本是奇迹。若有丑陋，那并非世界的错，而是我内在的残缺，刺痛了我。
quoteEn: To me, the world is a wonderful place... it is not the world that is ugly, it is my own imperfections that offend me.

author: 海伦·凯勒
quoteCn: 世间万物，皆苦。然，亦皆可渡。
quoteEn: All the world is full of suffering. It is also full of overcoming.

author: 亨利·扬曼
quoteCn: 我曾是那个在悬崖边起舞的人，如今却安居于一个，静谧到有些陌生的街区。
quoteEn: I used to live on the edge. Now I live in a neighborhood that’s a little too quiet.

author: 亨利·扬曼
quoteCn: 舌头生来并非只为言语，有时，无声亦是千言。
quoteEn: Just because you have a tongue doesn’t mean you have to use it.

author: 亨利·扬曼
quoteCn: 我曾是个素食者，直到我开始渴望阳光的滋养，像植物般向光而生。
quoteEn: I was a vegetarian until I started leaning toward the sunlight.

author: 亨利·马蒂斯
quoteCn: 我常以色彩为思绪，它们是我的语言，我的心跳。
quoteEn: I often think in terms of color.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 芸芸众生，皆在无声的绝望中度日。
quoteEn: The mass of men lead lives of quiet desperation.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 万物皆如旧，唯我心已迁。
quoteEn: Things do not change; we change.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 我们的生命，常被琐碎消磨殆尽。请简化，再简化。
quoteEn: Our life is frittered away by detail. Simplify, simplify.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 这世界，不过是我们心之所向的画布。
quoteEn: This world is but a canvas to our imagination.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 如果他无法与周遭的步伐同步，那或许，是因为他正聆听着，只属于自己的那一声鼓点。
quoteEn: If a man does not keep pace with his companions, perhaps it is because he hears a different drummer.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 我走进森林，只为活得更深沉，只为直面生命最本真的底色。
quoteEn: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life.

author: 亨利·马蒂斯
quoteCn: 创造，是生命的回响，是灵魂的再体验。
quoteEn: To create is to live twice.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 我唯一该向自己许下的承诺，是在任何时刻，都只听从内心深处那份对“正确”的笃定。
quoteEn: The only obligation which I have a right to assume is to do at any time what I think right.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 爱，本无解药，唯有以更深沉的爱去回应。
quoteEn: There is no remedy for love but to love more.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 天堂，不只在遥不可及的彼岸，更深藏于我们脚下的每寸土地，与头顶的浩瀚星空同在。
quoteEn: Heaven is under our feet as well as over our heads.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 比起爱、金钱、声名，我更渴望那赤裸裸的真相。
quoteEn: Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 你所珍视的一切，都以你生命的一部分作为交换。每一次选择，都是一场与时间的深情对望。
quoteEn: The price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 你所追逐的终点，远不如追逐本身，将你塑造成何种模样，来得意义深远。
quoteEn: What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving your goals.

author: 亨利·马蒂斯
quoteCn: 重要的从来不是事物本身，而是它在你心中激荡起的那份情感涟漪。
quoteEn: It is not the subject that counts, it is the emotion that it evokes.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 你以为消磨的是时光，却不知，你伤害的，是永恒。
quoteEn: As if you could kill time without injuring eternity.

author: 亨利·马蒂斯
quoteCn: 世间万物，再无甚能比一个全然活出真我的女子更稀有、更动人。她本真，她独一无二，那便是最美的风景。
quoteEn: There is nothing more rare, nor more beautiful, than a woman being herself; authentic and unique.

author: 亨利·马蒂斯
quoteCn: 如果我能用言语尽述其意，那画笔便失去了存在的意义。
quoteEn: If I could tell you what it meant, there would be no point in painting.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 唯有我们真正醒来，那一天才算真正破晓。
quoteEn: Only that day dawns to which we are awake.

author: 亨利·马蒂斯
quoteCn: 艺术的使命，是温柔地拾回我们遗落的碎片。
quoteEn: The function of a work of art is to give us back what we have lost.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 我们无法承载他人的期许，唯有活出自己。
quoteEn: We cannot live other people's expectations. We must live our own.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 真正的幸福与安宁，在于释怀对一个“本该更好”的过去的执念。
quoteEn: To be truly happy and content, you must let go of the desire for a better past.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 终点并非某处，而是你眼中万物焕然一新的视角。
quoteEn: One’s destination is never a place, but a new way of seeing things.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 别去忧虑孩子是否听从你的言语，真正该深思的是，他们无时无刻不在凝视着你，模仿着你。
quoteEn: Do not worry that your children never listen to you; worry that they are always watching you.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 人生至恸，非苦难无尽，而是苦难深重，却无人共担。
quoteEn: The greatest tragedy of life is not that there is no suffering, but that we have to suffer alone.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 无论是在思想的旷野，还是在人世的洪流，我们都必须准备好，被误解。
quoteEn: Both in the realm of ideas and in the world of men, one must be prepared to be misunderstood.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 心有所燃，方谓生之所在。
quoteEn: To have passion is to be alive.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 生命中，有太多我们曾深信不疑的，如今却需要我们温柔地，一一去“忘却”。
quoteEn: There are so many things that we must learn to unlearn.

author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
quoteCn: 重要的并非你眼之所及，而是你心之所见。
quoteEn: It's not what you look at that matters, it's what you see.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 唯有当灵魂苏醒，我们才能真正触碰世界的深邃与意义。
quoteEn: It is only through the soul that we can begin to engage with the world in a meaningful way.

author: 亨利·福特
quoteCn: 你生命中最大的惊喜，莫过于发现自己原来可以做到那些曾让你望而却步的事情。
quoteEn: One of the greatest discoveries a man makes, one of his greatest surprises, is to find he can do what he was afraid he couldn’t do.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 一个人，得先深深爱上这趟生命之旅，才能甘愿承受它所附带的一切磨砺与心碎。
quoteEn: A man has to be in love with life to put up with all the suffering it entails.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 穷尽一生追逐幸福，却从未真正拥有过它。
quoteEn: I have spent my life in the pursuit of happiness, and I have never found it.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 那些心怀恐惧的人，往往会戴上一副虚假的面具。
quoteEn: The man who is afraid will often put on a false front.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 生命并非由宏大的里程碑定义，而是由那些微小、转瞬即逝的片刻温柔地编织而成。
quoteEn: Life is not a matter of milestones, but of moments.

author: 亨利·摩尔
quoteCn: 艺术并非高高在上的思想结晶，它就是生活本身，被放大、被点亮，闪耀着生命的光华。
quoteEn: The purpose of art is not a rarified, intellectual distillation; it is life, intensified, brilliant life.

author: 亨利·米勒
quoteCn: 纯真，是灵魂深处一场不设防的狂想。
quoteEn: Innocence is a kind of insanity.

author: 亨利·摩尔
quoteCn: 艺术的使命，在于抚慰那些心绪不宁的灵魂，并唤醒那些沉溺于安逸的麻木。
quoteEn: Art should comfort the disturbed and disturb the comfortable.

author: 亨利·摩尔
quoteCn: 成为一名艺术家，便是深信生命本身。
quoteEn: To be an artist is to believe in life.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 成为诗人，那是一种灵魂的境况，而非谋生的营生。
quoteEn: To be a poet is a condition, not a profession.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 真正的艺术，是于寻常处，见不凡之美。
quoteEn: It is a great artist’s art to see beauty in the ordinary.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 当雨落下来时，我们能做的最好之事，就是允许它落下，不抗拒，不强求。
quoteEn: The best thing one can do when it’s raining is to let it rain.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 破损的衣衫易于修补，可那伤人的重言，却会瘀伤孩子的心扉。
quoteEn: A torn jacket is soon mended; but hard words bruise the heart of a child.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 生命中总有风雨，这是常态。只是，我这里，雨水似乎从未停歇。
quoteEn: Into each life some rain must fall, but too much is falling in mine.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 过往的幽影，无声地，却又深刻地，烙印在未来的画布上。
quoteEn: The shadows of the past are cast upon the future.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 啊，那感觉真好啊！是老朋友的手。
quoteEn: Ah, how good it feels! The hand of an old friend.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 在每个灵魂深处，都藏匿着一份不与世俗同流的珍宝。
quoteEn: In every person, there is something precious that does not fit into the world.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 别去信赖任何未来，哪怕它描绘得再美好。让那些已死的过去，自行埋葬它的亡魂吧。
quoteEn: Trust no future, howe'er pleasant! Let the dead past bury its dead!

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 宇宙的乐章，只为那颗能感受的心而奏。
quoteEn: The music of the spheres is heard only by the heart.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 世间若有真理，那便是我们，是这具承载着爱恨、迷惘与觉醒的血肉之躯。
quoteEn: There is only one truth, and that truth is man.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 爱与渴望，生命中那两股最深沉、最澎湃的潮汐。
quoteEn: Love and longing are two of the strongest forces of life.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 每个人都是一道等待被温柔拆解的谜题，深藏着只有自己才能触及的答案。
quoteEn: Every human being is a puzzle that must be solved.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 芸芸众生，心绪总在无休止的躁动中浮沉。
quoteEn: Most people live in a constant restlessness.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 艺术，是与生命无常共舞，并从中汲取力量的温柔韧性。
quoteEn: Art is the ability to endure life.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 寻觅真我，是此生最深沉的馈赠。
quoteEn: The discovery of the self is the most valuable treasure.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 我曾向空中射出一箭，它坠落何方，我无从知晓。
quoteEn: I shot an arrow into the air, it fell to earth, I knew not where.

author: 亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗
quoteCn: 初雪，是人间一场纯粹的魔法降临。
quoteEn: The first snowfall is a moment of pure magic.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 生活的至高艺术，是于寻常处，瞥见不凡的微光。
quoteEn: The true art of living is to see the marvelous in the ordinary.

author: 赫拉克利特
quoteCn: 你永远无法踏入同一条河流，因为河水已非昨日之水，你也非昨日的你。
quoteEn: You cannot step into the same river twice

author: 希波克拉底
quoteCn: 我们内在的生命力，才是真正疗愈一切的良药。
quoteEn: Natural forces within us are the true healers of disease.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 人唯有在失去中，方能寻回所失。
quoteEn: A person can only find what he loses.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 每个人都是一片苍穹，总要承载几缕浮云。
quoteEn: Every human being is a sky, and has to bear a few clouds.

author: 希波克拉底
quoteCn: 疗愈，是时间温柔的抚慰，亦是某个瞬间，机遇之光乍现的奇迹。
quoteEn: Healing is a matter of time, but it is sometimes also a matter of opportunity.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 通往真我的旅途，往往始于与他人的相遇。
quoteEn: The way to yourself leads through another person.

author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
quoteCn: 我们与一些事物渐行渐远，并非因为厌倦，而是因为再也无法承受它们带来的重负。
quoteEn: Man separates from things because one can no longer endure them.

author: 贺拉斯
quoteCn: 抓住此刻吧，别把太多希望寄托给不可知的明天。
quoteEn: Seize the day, putting as little trust as possible in the future.

author: 希波克拉底
quoteCn: 重要的不是病症本身，而是承受病痛的那个鲜活的生命。
quoteEn: It is far more important to know what person the disease has than what disease the person has.

author: 希波克拉底
quoteCn: 有时，最好的疗愈，是允许自己什么都不做。
quoteEn: To do nothing is sometimes a good remedy.

author: 贺拉斯
quoteCn: 唉，那些转瞬即逝的岁月啊，悄然滑走，不留痕迹。
quoteEn: Eheu, the fleeting years slide away.

author: 希波克拉底
quoteCn: 病榻之上，心绪如麻，何谈明智抉择。
quoteEn: In sickness the mind is not a good counselor.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 本书所载，皆可存疑。它可能全然谬误，却也因此，更显真实。
quoteEn: Everything in this book may be wrong.

author: 贺拉斯
quoteCn: 穿越困境，抵达星辰。那份光芒，是你我历经磨砺的印记。
quoteEn: To the stars through difficulties

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 一场直抵美国梦腹地的，原始而狂野的远征。
quoteEn: A savage journey to the heart of the American Dream.

author: 贺拉斯
quoteCn: 本性如野草，即便被铁叉无情铲除，它依然会在心底深处，悄然复苏。
quoteEn: Nature, if driven out with a fork, will nonetheless return.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 你无法阻止命运的浪潮，但至少，你可以学着与它共舞。
quoteEn: You can't stop the waves, but you can learn to surf.

author: 贺拉斯
quoteCn: 我所拥有的一切，都已内化于心，随我而行。
quoteEn: All that is mine I carry with me.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 这不过是一场粗粝的对话，我与自己低语，再将它刻录成文。
quoteEn: It's a crude form of dialogue, really, in which I'm talking to myself and writing it down.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 我有个理论：那些真正的真相，从不在朝九晚五的庸常里显现。
quoteEn: I have a theory that the truth is never told during the nine-to-five hours.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 我想，症结在于这世上可供灵魂栖息的港湾，实在太少。
quoteEn: I think the problem is that there are not enough places to go.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 我向来独行，故而笔耕不辍。
quoteEn: I’ve always been a loner, and that’s why I write.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 有些事，真的无法言明，因为只有那些真正经历过、抵达彼岸的人，才懂得其中滋味。
quoteEn: There is no honest way to explain it because the only people who really know where it is are the ones who have gone over.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 时光无法倒转，但你可以选择再次为生命上弦，让它重新律动。
quoteEn: You can't turn back the clock. But you can wind it up again.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 当世界变得荒诞不经，那些特立独行的人，反而找到了自己的舞台，成为了真正的行家。
quoteEn: When the going gets weird, the weird turn pro.

author: 贺拉斯
quoteCn: 活在当下，别把希望全寄托给不可知的明天。
quoteEn: Seize the day, put as little trust as possible in the future.

author: 艾萨克·阿西莫夫
quoteCn: 生命此刻最令人心碎的，莫过于科学疾驰于知识的瀚海，而人类社会的智慧，却在原地踯躅。
quoteEn: The saddest aspect of life right now is that science gathers knowledge faster than society gathers wisdom.

author: 艾萨克·阿西莫夫
quoteCn: 生命，是温柔的馈赠；死亡，是最终的安宁。唯有其间的渡口，才让人心生波澜。
quoteEn: Life is pleasant. Death is peaceful. It's the transition that's troublesome.

author: 艾萨克·阿西莫夫
quoteCn: 我渐渐明白，生命中那些看似荒唐的、不合时宜的片刻，恰恰是通往真正洞见的幽径。
quoteEn: It has been my experience that a certain amount of foolishness is the best way to be wise.

author: 艾萨克·阿西莫夫
quoteCn: 对生于斯长于斯者而言，每一颗星球，都是他们的“地球”。
quoteEn: Any planet is 'Earth' to those that live on it.

author: 艾萨克·阿西莫夫
quoteCn: 人生不是棋局，被将死后，故事才真正开始。
quoteEn: In life, unlike chess, the game continues after checkmate.

author: 艾萨克·牛顿
quoteCn: 我们所知的，不过是沧海一粟；我们未知的，却是无垠的深海。
quoteEn: What we know is a drop, what we don't know is an ocean.

author: 艾萨克·阿西莫夫
quoteCn: 那些独自摸索、独自领悟的时刻，是生命里谁也无法夺走的馈赠。
quoteEn: You cannot take away the experience of having to figure things out for yourself.

author: 艾萨克·牛顿
quoteCn: 我能精准测算星辰的轨迹，却无力丈量人心的癫狂。
quoteEn: I can calculate the motion of heavenly bodies, but not the madness of people.

author: 艾萨克·牛顿
quoteCn: 学海无涯，方知己之渺小；求索愈深，愈觉万物之浩瀚。
quoteEn: The more I study, the more I realize I know nothing.

author: 艾萨克·牛顿
quoteCn: 世人如何看我，我不得而知。于我而言，不过是海边拾贝的孩童，如此而已。
quoteEn: I do not know what I may appear to the world, but to myself I seem to have been only like a boy playing on the sea shore.

author: 杰·科尔
quoteCn: 真正重要的，是你如何看待自己，如何与内在的自我对话。
quoteEn: The only thing that matters is how you feel about yourself.

author: 艾萨克·牛顿
quoteCn: 在我眼前，真理的浩瀚海洋，依然波澜不惊地等待着我的探索。
quoteEn: The great ocean of truth lay all undiscovered before me.

author: 亨特·S·汤姆pson
quoteCn: 买下这张票吧，去赴这场命定的旅程。
quoteEn: Buy the ticket, take the ride.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 你对眼前的一切都心生厌倦。
quoteEn: You don’t like anything that’s happening.

author: 杰·科尔
quoteCn: 众生皆有死期，然，非人人得尝生命之真味。
quoteEn: Everybody dies, but not everybody lives.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 在这世间摸索前行，何其艰难。
quoteEn: It's so hard to find your way around in this world.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 人生苦短，却有太多时光虚掷，徒留一声叹息。
quoteEn: It’s really too bad that so much of life is a waste of time.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 我是你此生见过最擅长说谎的人，这感觉糟透了。
quoteEn: I'm the most terrific liar you ever saw in your life. It's awful.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 不成熟的灵魂，总想轰轰烈烈地为某个信念献身；而真正成熟的智慧，却懂得为它默默无闻地，温柔地活下去。
quoteEn: The mark of the immature man is that he wants to die nobly for a cause, while the mark of the mature man is that he wants to live humbly for one.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 这世界充斥着虚伪，而你所有的努力，不过是为了习得那点所谓的聪明，好在某天，能买得起一辆该死的凯迪拉克。
quoteEn: It's full of phonies, and all you do is study so that you can learn enough to be smart enough to be able to buy a goddam Cadillac some day.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 我是这世上，独一无二的自己。
quoteEn: I’m the only person in the world that’s just like me.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 我们都曾是那个在魔豆故事里，身陷困境、心事重重的杰克。
quoteEn: We are all of us in the Dumps with Jack and the Beanstalk.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 如果你还想感受生命的脉动，那些深藏心底的话，就非说不可。
quoteEn: If you want to stay alive, you have to say that stuff, though.

author: 杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格
quoteCn: 我所求的，仅此而已。我所求的，不过是说出那份真实。
quoteEn: It's what I want to do. All I want to do is to tell the truth.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 并非所有跋涉者，都迷失了方向。
quoteEn: Not all those who wander are lost.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 这世间仍有美好，值得我们拼尽全力去守护。
quoteEn: There is some good in this world, and it’s worth fighting for.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 长路漫漫，无尽无休，它从你启程的门扉，一直延伸到远方。
quoteEn: The road goes ever on and on, down from the door where it began.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 世事并非表象所呈现，初见的幻象常使人深陷迷途。
quoteEn: Things are not always what they seem; the first appearance deceives many.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 家园已远，世界在前，万千征途，皆是我的路。
quoteEn: Home is behind, the world ahead, and there are many paths to tread.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 若我们能将美食、欢声与歌谣看得比囤积的黄金更重，这世界，定会更加欢愉。
quoteEn: If more of us valued food and cheer and song above hoarded gold, it would be a merrier world.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 那些无声的英勇，从不因无人赞颂而失色。
quoteEn: Deeds will not be less valiant because they are unpraised.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 我多么希望这一切，不曾发生在我所处的时代。
quoteEn: I wish it need not have happened in my time.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 佛罗多，每当你推开家门，都是一场未知的冒险，充满危险，也充满可能。
quoteEn: It’s a dangerous business, Frodo, going out your door.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 唯有穿行过至暗的阴影，方能抵达破晓的晨光。
quoteEn: You can only come to the morning through the shadows.

author: 托尔金
quoteCn: 很高兴你与我同在，在这万物初生的时刻。
quoteEn: I am glad you are here with me. Here at the beginning of all things.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 我们深知，世界将再也无法复原如初。
quoteEn: We knew the world would not be the same.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 此刻，我即是死亡，是万界的毁灭者。
quoteEn: Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 自然无秘，人心藏匿。世间万物坦荡无遗，唯有思绪与意图，深不可测，幽微难明。
quoteEn: There are no secrets about the world of nature. There are secrets about the thoughts and intentions of men.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 物理学家们已然尝尽罪孽的滋味；这份刻骨铭心的认知，将如影随形，永不磨灭。
quoteEn: The physicists have known sin; and this is a knowledge which they cannot lose.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 每一位科学家，都必须对自己的所作所为心怀敬畏与恐惧。
quoteEn: Every scientist has to be afraid for what he is doing.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 我想，物理学家们已然尝到了罪的滋味。
quoteEn: I think the physicists have known sin.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 生命，本就该是一场淋漓尽致的体验，而那份对未知的渴望，更应永不熄灭。
quoteEn: Life must be lived and curiosity kept alive.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 有人问我为何不写回忆录，我答：因为我的生命，此刻正是我活着的篇章，我仍在其中，未完待续。
quoteEn: Some people ask why I do not write my memoirs and I say that they are my life, and I am still living it.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 某种粗粝的觉醒，超越了所有世俗的喧嚣、戏谑与夸张，物理学家们，已然触碰了原罪。
quoteEn: In some sort of crude sense which no vulgarity, no humor, no overstatement can quite extinguish, the physicists have known sin.

author: 朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默
quoteCn: 某种粗粝的觉知，无论世俗的喧嚣、轻佻的戏谑，抑或夸张的言辞，都无法将其彻底抹去——物理学家们已然触碰了罪孽的深渊；而这份刻骨铭心的认知，将永远如影随形，无法摆脱。
quoteEn: In some sort of crude sense which no vulgarity, no humor, no overstatement can quite extinguish, the physicists have known sin; and this is a knowledge which they cannot lose.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 太多人误以为我只是个传说，一个被符号化的幻影。
quoteEn: Too many guys think I'm a myth.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 唯有音乐，是那不朽的真言。
quoteEn: The only truth is music.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 我倾覆了一整座沟通的工厂，言语的齿轮轰然停转。
quoteEn: I dropped a whole factory of communication.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 我渴望，能亲手编织我的人生。
quoteEn: I want to be able to invent my own life.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 我们皆如皓月，自带暗面。光华万丈，亦有阴影深藏。
quoteEn: We are all like the bright moon, we still have our darker side.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 我多么希望能让你看见，当你身陷孤独或黑暗时，你自身所蕴藏的，那道令人惊叹的光芒。
quoteEn: I wish I could show you when you are lonely or in darkness the astonishing light of your own being.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 风，是世间最伟大的歌者。
quoteEn: The wind is a great singer.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 我的哲学，是寻一方素净之地，过一段清简人生。
quoteEn: My philosophy is to live a simple life, on a simple plot.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 我愿与你，共赴所有心惊与神迷的时刻。
quoteEn: I want to be with you in the moments of all fear and wonder.

author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
quoteCn: 身后已无牵挂，前方尽是未知与可能，人生之路，本就如此，永远向前。
quoteEn: Nothing behind me, everything ahead of me, as is ever so on the road.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 我就是我，不加掩饰，不曾退缩。我穷尽一生，只为活出这最本真的自我。
quoteEn: I am what I am. Doing my best to be what I am.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 并非所有直面的都能被改变，但若不曾直面，便无从谈及改变。
quoteEn: Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 在这个国度，作为一个黑人，只要稍有觉醒，便会发现自己几乎总是怒火中烧，那是一种无休止的、深植于骨髓的愤怒。
quoteEn: To be a Negro in this country and to be relatively conscious is to be in a rage almost all the time.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 爱，是那把温柔的刀，剥落我们曾以为赖以生存的面具，却也让我们看清，戴着它们，我们从未真正活过。
quoteEn: Love takes off the masks that we fear we cannot live without and know we cannot live within.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 自由不是谁能恩赐予你，而是你必须亲手去夺取。你渴望多大的自由，就能拥有多大的自由。
quoteEn: Freedom is not something that one person can give to another; freedom is something that people take, and people are as free as they want to be.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 你曾以为，这世上无人能懂你心底的痛与碎裂，直到你翻开书页，才发现，那些幽微的挣扎，早已被无数灵魂反复书写。
quoteEn: You think your pain and your heartbreak are unprecedented in the history of the world, but then you read.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 社会最危险的造物，是那个已然一无所有的人。
quoteEn: The most dangerous creation of any society is the man who has nothing to lose.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 我们是历史的囚徒，历史亦是我们灵魂深处的烙印。
quoteEn: People are trapped in history and history is trapped in them.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 此刻，未晚。但，我们必须启程。
quoteEn: It is not too late, but we must begin.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 如果你的语言里没有“不”这个字，那么，你必须亲手把它铸造出来。
quoteEn: If the word 'No' is not in the language, you have to make it up.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 我无法相信你口中的承诺，因为我眼中所见，是你行动的背叛。
quoteEn: I can't believe what you say, because I see what you do.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 或许，家并非一处居所，而是一种无可逆转的生命境遇。
quoteEn: Perhaps home is not a place but simply an irrevocable condition.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 艺术家并非生来与众不同，而是每个人，都以自己独特的方式，雕刻着生命的艺术。
quoteEn: The artist is not a special kind of person; rather each person is a special kind of artist.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 历史的残酷在于，一个人曾挣脱枷锁，却又被无形之手重新束缚。
quoteEn: This is the horror of history: how a person can be freed and made a slave again.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 世间万般风华，皆不及一颗温柔心所散发的魅力。
quoteEn: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 你必须决定自己是谁，然后，让世界去面对那个真实的你，而非它为你虚构的幻影。
quoteEn: You have to decide who you are and force the world to deal with you, not with its idea of you.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 在晴朗的日子里，寻一处树荫静坐，凝望满目苍翠，这便是最完美的慰藉。
quoteEn: To sit in the shade on a fine day and look upon verdure is the most perfect refreshment.

author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温
quoteCn: 此刻的每一步，都在雕刻我生命长卷中的永恒印记。
quoteEn: Everything now, in fact, is about how I can turn the moment into history.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 洞悉你内心的幸福。你所缺的，不过是那份沉静的耐心——若要赋予它更动人的名字，不妨称之为希望。
quoteEn: Know your own happiness. You want nothing but patience - or give it a more fascinating name, call it hope.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 自私啊，你得明白，那是一种无药可医的顽疾，所以我们总得学着去原谅。
quoteEn: Selfishness must always be forgiven you know, because there is no hope of a cure.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 请允许我，将这份炽热的爱慕与深情，向你倾诉。
quoteEn: You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 这世上，一半的人永远无法真正懂得另一半人的欢愉。
quoteEn: One half of the world cannot understand the pleasures of the other.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 婚姻并非我所笃信，但真爱已然在我心中生根。
quoteEn: I am not a great believer in marriage, but I have become a believer in true love.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 真正的安宁，莫过于在家中寻得。
quoteEn: There is nothing like staying at home for real comfort.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 在爱里，我们都曾是，或终将是，那个义无反顾的傻瓜。
quoteEn: We are all fools in love.

author: 杰伊-泽
quoteCn: 你曾许诺给我整个世界，而我，竟真的信以为真了。
quoteEn: You promised the world and I fell for it.

author: 简·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 我已无法追溯，究竟是哪一个时辰、哪一方天地、哪一眼凝视，抑或哪一句低语，悄然埋下了这份情愫的根基。时光流逝太久，彼时我正身陷其中，不自知，不自察。
quoteEn: I cannot fix on the hour, or the spot, or the look, or the words, which laid the foundation. It is too long ago. I was in the middle of the process.

author: 让-雅克·卢梭
quoteCn: 人生而自由，却处处身陷囹圄。
quoteEn: Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.

author: 让-雅克·卢梭
quoteCn: 去感受吧，更深地感受，那才是真正的活着。
quoteEn: We must feel more, that is to say, live more.

author: 让-雅克·卢梭
quoteCn: 自由，并非随心所欲的放纵，而是拥有拒绝不愿之事的力量。
quoteEn: Freedom consists less in doing what one wants than in not doing what one does not want.

author: 让-雅克·卢梭
quoteCn: 幸福并非堆砌的财富，而是灵魂深处那份无拘无束的自由。
quoteEn: It is not so much wealth that brings happiness as the freedom of the spirit.

author: 让-雅克·卢梭
quoteCn: 真正的幸福，并非外求，它就安然栖息于你此刻的存在之中。
quoteEn: True happiness is inherent in existence.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 人，注定要承受自由的重负。
quoteEn: Man is condemned to be free.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 我们的存在，本就无需任何理由。
quoteEn: There is no justification for our existence.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 当言语被吞噬，那未发之声便化作无尽的煎熬。
quoteEn: The silence of men is a form of misery.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 焦虑，是自由在深渊边缘的颤栗。
quoteEn: Anxiety is the vertigo of freedom.

author: 让-雅克·卢梭
quoteCn: 爱，从不因循教条的强求而生。
quoteEn: One doesn't make oneself loved by force of precepts.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 唯有言语，在时间洪流中，刻下永恒的印记。
quoteEn: Words are all that remain.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 人的存在，是无限自由的投射与创造。
quoteEn: Human existence is a project of infinite freedom.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 自由，是你亲手雕琢的模样，是你选择的重量与光芒。
quoteEn: Freedom is what you make of it.

author: 杰伊-泽
quoteCn: 头衔固然耀眼，但真正支撑我、定义我的，是我身边那些珍贵的人。
quoteEn: What’s more important than a title? The people around me.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 生命，本就是一场无章可循的即兴演出。
quoteEn: Life is a game without rules.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 所谓的“自欺”，不过是灵魂深处，对自己编织的一场谎言。
quoteEn: Bad faith is a lie to oneself.

author: 让-雅克·卢梭
quoteCn: 孤独，是孕育自由的温床。
quoteEn: Solitude is the cradle of freedom.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 我们被判罚，去承受那份沉重的自由。
quoteEn: We are condemned to be free.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 当爱满溢，恐惧便无处遁形。
quoteEn: When there is love, there is no fear.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 不带评判地去观照，是心智最深邃的洞察。
quoteEn: The ability to observe without evaluating is the highest form of intelligence.

author: 耶稣基督
quoteCn: 别为明日愁，明日自有明日的烦忧。
quoteEn: Do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 我们真正需要的，并非粗暴地斩断旧习，而是深入其内核，洞悉它们生长的土壤与纹理。
quoteEn: What is necessary is not the breaking of habits, but the understanding of them.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 活在这纷扰人间，却不被其所困，这本身就是一场修行。
quoteEn: The challenge is to live in the world without being attached to it.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 你即是这广袤世界，而这世界，亦是你内在的投映。
quoteEn: You are the world, and the world is you.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 真理，本就无迹可寻。它不栖身于任何宗教的殿堂，也不依附于任何教派的藩篱。它只存在于你向内探寻的刹那。
quoteEn: Truth has no path. You cannot come to it through any religion, through any sect.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 幸福之路，本就无迹可循，唯有步履不停，方能走出自己的风景。
quoteEn: There is no pre-established path to happiness.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 当悲伤落幕，智慧才真正启幕。
quoteEn: The ending of sorrow is the beginning of wisdom.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 洞悉自我，方能开启智慧之门。
quoteEn: Self-knowledge is the beginning of wisdom.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 当爱意流淌，心湖澄澈，真理便自然显现。
quoteEn: Clarity is the outcome of love.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 凝视是本能，洞见是修行。
quoteEn: To look is one thing, but to see is another.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 在一个病入膏肓的社会里，你若能安之若素，那绝非健康的证明，而是一种更深的病态。
quoteEn: It is no measure of health to be well adjusted to a profoundly sick society.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 我们大多数人，生来就被设定了程序，去追逐那些闪光的欢愉，而对所有刺痛的苦楚，则本能地避之不及。
quoteEn: Most of us are conditioned to seek pleasure and avoid pain.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 当你全然接纳此刻的自己，不加评判，不强求改变，那份真实的你，便会在无声无息中，悄然蜕变。
quoteEn: If you begin to understand what you are without trying to change it, then what you are undergoes a transformation.

author: 吉姆·凯瑞
quoteCn: 恐惧终将是你生命中的一位常客，但你拥有选择，决定它能占据你心房的几分之地。
quoteEn: Fear is going to be a player in your life, you get to decide how much.

author: 吉姆·凯瑞
quoteCn: 你对被认可的渴望，有时会让你在这世间，渐渐失去自己的轮廓，变得透明。
quoteEn: Your need for acceptance can make you invisible in this world.

author: 吉姆·凯瑞
quoteCn: 我选择，放自己自由。我选择，卸下那些紧缚我太久的焦虑。
quoteEn: I choose to free myself. I choose to let go of all the anxiety that I’ve held onto so long.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 当你试图丈量自我，你已然戴上假面，远离了本真。
quoteEn: The moment you have a measure of yourself, you are pretending.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 你只能是你自己，无法成为他人，也无需成为他人。
quoteEn: You can only be yourself, and not the other.

author: 吉姆·凯瑞
quoteCn: 愿世人皆可功成名就，坐拥万物所求，方知此非终极答案。
quoteEn: I wish everyone could get rich and famous and have everything they ever dreamed of, so they would know that it's not the answer.

author: 吉姆·凯瑞
quoteCn: 有时，我们被蒙蔽双眼，并非因为前方空无一物，而是因为心头横亘着那块，名为执念或恐惧的巨石。唯有亲手将其挪开，才能看清，原来光明一直都在。
quoteEn: Sometimes you can’t see what’s in front of you until you remove the blockage.

author: 吉姆·凯瑞
quoteCn: 你心中对他人那份温柔的向往，其实是你馈赠给自己最珍贵的礼物。
quoteEn: The desire you have for others is the greatest gift you can give yourself.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 放下对答案的执念，才是真正触及问题核心的开始。
quoteEn: Freedom from the desire for an answer is essential to the understanding of a problem.

author: 吉姆·马蒂斯
quoteCn: 没有人能将我们从自我设下的困境中解救。
quoteEn: No one is going to protect us from ourselves.

author: 吉姆·凯瑞
quoteCn: 面具并非戴在我脸前，它已然，成为了我。
quoteEn: The mask is not in front of me. The mask has become me.

author: 吉姆·凯瑞
quoteCn: 生活从不是对你的『发生』，而是为你而『绽放』。
quoteEn: Life doesn’t happen to you, it happens for you.

author: 吉米·亨德里克斯
quoteCn: 知识滔滔不绝，而智慧静默倾听。
quoteEn: Knowledge speaks, but wisdom listens.

author: 吉米·亨德里克斯
quoteCn: 蓝调易弹，却难感其魂。它不只是音符，更是那些深埋心底，难以言说的痛与真。
quoteEn: The blues are easy to play, but hard to feel.

author: 吉米·亨德里克斯
quoteCn: 即便此生再无音符可弹，又何妨？我只愿，我就是我。
quoteEn: I don't care if I never play another note. I just want to be me.

author: 吉米·亨德里克斯
quoteCn: 我所经历的一切，都指向一个真相：我的现实，皆由我心所塑。
quoteEn: The experience I had was that it was all me creating my own reality.

author: 吉米·亨德里克斯
quoteCn: 当死亡的钟声敲响，那是我一个人的谢幕。所以，请允许我，以我渴望的方式，燃烧此生。
quoteEn: I'm the one who has to die when it's time for me to die, so let me live my life the way I want to.

author: 基督慕里提
quoteCn: 在放手的过程中，你会与过往的许多事物告别，却也因此，与真正的自己重逢。
quoteEn: In the process of letting go, you will lose many things from the past, but you will find yourself.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 如果真有我的天堂，那一定是与一片海滩相连的。
quoteEn: If there's a heaven for me, I'm sure it has a beach attached.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 是我咎由自取，怨不得旁人。
quoteEn: It's my own damn fault.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 让生命如歌般流淌，旋律起伏，皆是风景。
quoteEn: Live life like a song.

author: 吉米·亨德里克斯
quoteCn: 我渴望与你们无限贴近，用我的音乐，触碰你们灵魂最深处。
quoteEn: I want to get as close to the audience as I can—touch them with my music.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 最终，我将这一切视作一份馈赠。
quoteEn: In the end, I think of it as a gift.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 我深谙世间荒诞，却不愿随波逐流。
quoteEn: I have a fine sense of the ridiculous, but no sense of the ridiculous.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 没有什么比大海，更能让我真切地感受到生命的存在与澎湃。
quoteEn: There's nothing that makes me feel more alive than the ocean.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 当你掌控一切，那便不是一场冒险，而是一段被预设的旅程。真正的冒险，总在失控的边缘绽放。
quoteEn: When you’re in control, it’s not an adventure.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 总有些日子，你需要亲手为自己点亮一束阳光。
quoteEn: Some days you just have to create your own sunshine.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 再次沉溺于玛格丽塔的微醺，任由时光虚度，心绪也随之飘散。
quoteEn: Wasting away again in Margaritaville

author: 吉米·卡特
quoteCn: 每一次由衷的欢庆，都是我们走向内在疗愈的第一步。
quoteEn: Celebration is the beginning of healing.

author: 吉米·卡特
quoteCn: 和平，远不止战火的平息。它更是一种内在的澄明，一种心境的安宁。
quoteEn: Peace is not merely the absence of war. It is also a state of mind.

author: 圣女贞德
quoteCn: 我循着那份召唤，义无反顾地前行。
quoteEn: I go where I am called, without hesitation.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 风向难测，我无力扭转，但掌稳风帆，总能驶向心之所向。
quoteEn: I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination.

author: 吉米·巴菲特
quoteCn: 我们终究活成了父母曾告诫我们不要成为的样子。
quoteEn: We are the people our parents warned us about.

author: 乔·罗根
quoteCn: 宇宙，从不曾承诺为你清晰。它只是存在，而我们，在其中寻找意义。
quoteEn: The universe is under no obligation to make sense to you.

author: 乔·罗根
quoteCn: 你所渴望的一切，都在恐惧的另一边等你。
quoteEn: Everything is on the other side of fear.

author: 乔尔·奥斯汀
quoteCn: 别再苦等风暴平息，去学着在雨中翩然起舞吧。
quoteEn: You cannot wait for the storm to pass; you must learn to dance in the rain.

author: 约翰·克鲁伊夫
quoteCn: 每个人都有自己的节奏和光芒，无需比较，更无所谓对错。你的独特，本身就是一种圆满。
quoteEn: Each has its own style. There’s no right or wrong.

author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
quoteCn: 世间至美，非眼所见，非手可触，唯心可感。
quoteEn: The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched, they must be felt with the heart.

author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
quoteCn: 生命属于那些真正活着的人，而活着，就意味着要时刻准备好，去拥抱那永恒的变幻。
quoteEn: Life belongs to the living, and he who lives must be prepared for change.

author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
quoteCn: 不再去爱，不再犯错的人，就让他安息吧。因为那样的生命，已然枯萎。
quoteEn: He who no longer loves and no longer errs, let him be buried.

author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
quoteCn: 人若无梦，与朽木何异？
quoteEn: What is man if he does not dream?

author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
quoteCn: 世间至高的幸福，是知晓自己被爱。
quoteEn: The greatest happiness on earth is to be loved.

author: 约翰·D·洛克菲勒
quoteCn: 爱之外，再无他物能与慈悲比肩，它是世间最珍贵的馈赠。
quoteEn: Next to love, compassion is the greatest gift.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 耳畔的旋律固然甜美，但那未曾奏响的，却更令人心醉神迷。
quoteEn: Heard melodies are sweet, but those unheard are sweeter.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 美，是永恒的慰藉，是灵魂深处不朽的喜悦。
quoteEn: A thing of beauty is a joy forever.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 诗人，是他们自己世界的铸梦者。
quoteEn: A poet is a maker of their own world.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 我唯一能确信的，是心底那份纯粹情感的神圣，以及想象力所能触及的真实。
quoteEn: I am certain of nothing but the holiness of the heart's affections and the truth of imagination.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 美是真，真是美——这便是人间你所能领悟的全部，也是你唯一需要领悟的真谛。
quoteEn: Beauty is truth, truth beauty—that is all ye know on earth, and all ye need to know.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 每当我心潮涌动，我的心便如那盈溢的杯盏，盛满了无尽的情感。
quoteEn: And when I feel, my heart is like an overflowing cup.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 我沉溺于我自己的想象，那是灵魂最自由的栖息地。
quoteEn: I am in love with my own imagination.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 你可曾想过，这世间种种苦痛与磨难，正是淬炼心智、成就灵魂的必经之路？
quoteEn: Do you not see how necessary a world of pains and troubles is to school an intelligence and make it a soul?

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 大地的诗意，从未真正消逝，它只是以另一种形式，在某个不经意的瞬间，轻抚你的心弦。
quoteEn: The poetry of earth is never dead.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 美，是永恒的慰藉，是灵魂深处不朽的喜悦。
quoteEn: Endymion, a thing of beauty is a joy forever.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 那些被我们想象力紧紧抓住的美，本身就是一种真实。
quoteEn: What the imagination seizes as beauty must be truth.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 对我而言，此生已赴，便是最大的恩赐。
quoteEn: To me, the greatest thing is to have been alive.

author: 约翰·肯尼迪
quoteCn: 胜利是众星捧月，失败却无人问津。
quoteEn: Victory has a thousand fathers, but defeat is an orphan.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 我们被赋予了爱的恩赐，然而爱，却像一株需要悉心照料的珍贵植物。
quoteEn: We've got this gift of love, but love is like a precious plant.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 想象一下，所有人都能安然生活，心无芥蒂，世界归于宁静。
quoteEn: Imagine all the people living life in peace.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 当你忙着规划未来时，生活已在不经意间悄然发生。
quoteEn: Life is what happens while you are busy making other plans.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 不怪异，本身就是一种怪异。
quoteEn: It’s weird not to be weird.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 独自编织的梦，终究只是梦。而与人共筑的梦，才得以触及现实。
quoteEn: A dream you dream alone is only a dream. A dream you dream together is reality.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 你尽可以说我痴人说梦，但我知道，我并非孤身一人。
quoteEn: You may say I'm a dreamer, but I'm not the only one.

author: 约翰·肯尼迪
quoteCn: 我们并非生来诅咒黑暗，而是为了点亮那束光，引领自己穿越幽暗。
quoteEn: We are not here to curse the darkness, but to light the candle that can guide us through that darkness.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 我即是他，你亦是他，你亦是我，我们本就一体。
quoteEn: I am he as you are he as you are me and we are all together.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 我只是个梦想家，让生命在梦境中流淌。
quoteEn: I’m just a dreamer, I dream my life away.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 你看，我并非为你，也非为谁而奔波。我只是，为我自己而活。
quoteEn: You see, I'm not really working for you or for anyone else. I'm working for myself.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 你无需谁来定义你，你本自具足。
quoteEn: You don't need anybody to tell you who you are or what you are.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 我不惧怕死亡，因为它在我看来，并非终结。不过是灵魂从一辆旧车驶出，轻盈地步入另一辆崭新的旅程。
quoteEn: I'm not afraid of death because I don’t believe in it. It's just getting out of one car and getting into another.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 现实，总为我们的想象力，留下无尽的伏笔。
quoteEn: Reality leaves a lot to the imagination.

author: 约翰·列侬
quoteCn: 如果你真的渴望，战火便会平息。
quoteEn: War is over, if you want it.

author: 约翰·洛克
quoteCn: 那些羞于直面自己思想与行为的人，其内心深处，早已沦为无形的奴隶。
quoteEn: He that is ashamed of his own thoughts and deeds, is a slave at heart.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 与自然之心紧密相依，感受那份原始的脉动。
quoteEn: Keep close to nature's heart.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 每一次与自然的相遇，我们所得到的，总是远超我们所求的。那是一种不期而遇的丰盛，是灵魂深处被轻轻触碰的惊喜。
quoteEn: In every walk with nature one receives far more than he seeks.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 去感受自然最原始的野性，去拥抱那些让风景更显壮丽的馈赠，这本身就是一件多么荣耀而触及灵魂的事啊。
quoteEn: How glorious a task to see nature in her wildness, with her beauty-enhancing landscapes.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 通往宇宙最纯粹的路径，是穿梭于林间荒野。
quoteEn: The clearest way into the Universe is through a forest wilderness.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 融入自然，即是融入那最宏伟的艺术，成为其永恒的一部分。
quoteEn: To be a part of nature means to be part of the greatest work of art.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 大自然的宁静，如阳光穿透树梢般，缓缓流入我的心田。
quoteEn: Nature’s peace flows into me as sunshine flows into trees.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 阳光不只洒落我们身外，更是在我们心间熠熠生辉。
quoteEn: The sun shines not on us but in us.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 我本只是出门散步，却最终决定流连至日落。因为我发现，每一次向外的探寻，都是一场深刻的向内之旅。
quoteEn: I only went out for a walk and finally concluded to stay out till sundown, for going out, I found, was really going in.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 在每一对松树之间，都藏着一扇门，通往一种全新的生命姿态。
quoteEn: Between every two pine trees there is a door leading to a new way of life.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 生命，是场永无止境的创作，我们每个人都是自己作品的艺术家。
quoteEn: A man’s life is a continuous work of art.

author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
quoteCn: 人能为所欲为，却不能欲其所欲。这深邃的矛盾，道尽了自由意志的边界与潜意识的无形掌控。
quoteEn: The human can do what he wants, but he cannot want what he wants.

author: 约翰·洛克
quoteCn: 没有什么比对一个人说“我比你更懂你自己”更粗鲁的了。
quoteEn: There cannot be greater rudeness than to say to a man, 'I understand you better than you understand yourself.'

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 在荒芜的沙漠深处，竟有如此一道，伟大的光。
quoteEn: And in the desert, there was a great light.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 荒野，是灵魂得以卸下所有束缚，自由漫游的天地。
quoteEn: A wilderness is a place where the spirit can roam free.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 我一生中凝视过多少面孔，却从未真正看清过任何一个灵魂。
quoteEn: I wonder how many people I've looked at all my life and never seen.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 走向群山，即是回归本心。
quoteEn: Going to the mountains is going home.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 旅途如同一场婚姻。当你以为能完全掌控它时，恰恰是你走向迷途的开始。
quoteEn: A journey is like marriage. The certain way to be wrong is to think you control it.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 在众生灵魂的深处，那愤怒的葡萄正饱满欲裂，沉甸甸地，只待一个爆发的时刻。
quoteEn: In the souls of the people the grapes of wrath were filling and growing heavy, growing heavy for the vintage.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 我将竭力攫取此刻，让它彻底成为我的。
quoteEn: I shall strive to seize this moment that I have and make it mine.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 幸福并非一场需要你苦苦追寻的劳作，但要真正抵达那份快乐，却需要你付出深沉的努力与自我耕耘。
quoteEn: It is a paradox that you do not have to work for happiness, but you do have to work to be happy.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 当你身陷泥沼，心碎欲裂，或只是单纯需要一份援手时，去到那些一无所有的人身边吧。唯有他们，会不求回报地伸出双手，唯有他们。
quoteEn: If you’re in trouble or hurt or need—go to the poor people. They’re the only ones that’ll help—the only ones.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 那些曾盛放过欢声笑语的故地，一旦转身，便只剩心头沉甸甸的告别。
quoteEn: It’s a hard thing to leave any place where you have been happy.

author: 约翰·韦恩
quoteCn: 勇气，是明知前路惊涛骇浪，心底已然千疮百孔，却依然选择披挂上阵，策马扬鞭。
quoteEn: Courage is being scared to death... and saddling up anyway.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 你并非身处群山之中，而是群山栖居于你的灵魂深处。
quoteEn: You are not in the mountains. The mountains are in you.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 跟我说说吧，乔治。你这混蛋！你比我，快乐那么一点点。
quoteEn: Tell me about it, George. You bugger! You’re a little happier than I am!

author: 约翰·C·麦克斯威尔
quoteCn: 我们此生最大的谬误，莫过于在对犯错的无尽恐惧中，蹉跎了本该勇敢前行的岁月。
quoteEn: The greatest mistake we make is living in constant fear that we will make one.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 世间本无所谓罪恶，亦无所谓美德。有的，不过是众生百态，各自的悲欢离合。
quoteEn: There ain't no sin and there ain't no virtue. There's just stuff people do.

author: 约翰·卫斯理
quoteCn: 我燃尽自己，只为引来世人围观我化作灰烬。
quoteEn: I set myself on fire, and people come to watch me burn.

author: 约翰·韦恩
quoteCn: 如果命运注定你将跌倒，至少，让那跌倒发生在你的热爱里。
quoteEn: If you’re going to be a failure, at least be a failure at something you enjoy.

author: 约翰·缪尔
quoteCn: 又是一个光辉的日子，空气涌入肺腑，如同甘露滋润舌尖，如此甘美，令人心醉。
quoteEn: Another glorious day, the air as delicious to the lungs as nectar to the tongue.

author: 约翰·卫斯理
quoteCn: 愿你的言语，是你心底最真实的映照。
quoteEn: Let your words be the genuine picture of your heart.

author: 约翰·卫斯理
quoteCn: 你仅此一魂，你仅此一生。岁月如梭，转瞬即逝。你将如何安放它？
quoteEn: You have but one soul. You have but one life. It will soon be past. What will you do with it?

author: 约翰·卫斯理
quoteCn: 再微不足道的心事，都值得被温柔地托付给祈祷。
quoteEn: Nothing is too small to be put in prayer.

author: 约翰·伍登
quoteCn: 成功，是那份由衷的平静。它来自你深知，已倾尽所有，去抵达你所能成为的，最真实的自己。
quoteEn: Success is a peace of mind which is a direct result of self-satisfaction in knowing you did your best to become the best you are capable of becoming.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 我今日自伤，只为探寻心底是否仍有知觉。
quoteEn: I hurt myself today to see if I still feel.

author: 约翰·伍登
quoteCn: 若你未曾为那些无法回报你的人付出，你的一天便无法抵达真正的圆满。
quoteEn: You can't live a perfect day without doing something for someone who will never be able to repay you.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 我家与母亲的家之间，那段不算长的路，每一寸都刻着我独有的记忆，它们像老电影一样，在心头反复播放。
quoteEn: Between my house and my mother's house, there's a little stretch of road, and I have my own memories about it.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 你不能再这样下去了，是时候做出改变了。
quoteEn: You can't go on doing what you've been doing.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 成功，并非从此无忧，而是你终于可以不必为金钱烦恼，转而将心力投注于世间万象的深层忧虑。
quoteEn: Success is having to worry about everything in the world except money.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 我曾拥有狂喜的瞬间，也曾深陷锥心的痛楚。
quoteEn: I've had my moments of joy and my moments of pain.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 记忆啊，它从不容你挑拣。好的坏的，都是你来时的路，是你完整的模样。
quoteEn: You can’t pick and choose which of the good and the bad memories you want to keep.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 我从未将自己定义为局外人，只是循着内心的轨迹前行。
quoteEn: I never thought of myself as an outlaw.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 你亲手垒砌了那些高墙，却要用尽余生去拆解，去自由。
quoteEn: You build up these terrible walls, and then you spend the rest of your life trying to tear them down.

author: 约翰·卫斯理
quoteCn: 身之所在，心之所向，全然沉浸。
quoteEn: Wherever you are, be all there.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 我从未刻意扮演怪咖，我只是活出我本来的样子。
quoteEn: I don't pretend to be captain weird. I just do what I do.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 生命如炽，燃尽成环，那是你我曾走过的，滚烫的轨迹。
quoteEn: Life is a burning thing, and it makes a fiery ring.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 既然已身在此程，便尽情享受这趟旅途吧。
quoteEn: I think the thing to do is enjoy the ride while you're on it.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 世间哪有足够大的茶杯，能盛满我无尽的思绪；又何来足够长的书卷，能填补我灵魂深处的渴求。
quoteEn: You can never get a cup of tea large enough or a book long enough to suit me.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 我所珍爱的一切，都已沉淀在过往的时光里。
quoteEn: The things that I love are in the past.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 这世间万物，皆是旋律的流淌。而我们，终将归于那无尽的乐章。
quoteEn: All the world is made of music. We are all music in the end.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 我不是一个属于周日清晨的人。
quoteEn: I’m not a Sunday morning person.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 世上本无所谓“罪恶的快乐”。若心之所向，尽情沉溺，那便是纯粹的欢愉。
quoteEn: I don't believe in guilty pleasures. If you enjoy something, it's a pleasure.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 在这片混沌之中，我们是多么容易，就忘了何谓罪愆。
quoteEn: It's easy to forget what a sin is in the midst of all this chaos.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 魔鬼并非外物，它深植于我们的世界，更是我们思绪深处的暗流。
quoteEn: I think the devil is a part of our world. He's a part of our reasoning.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 我们终其一生，不过是渴望爱与被爱，仅此而已。
quoteEn: We’re all just human beings, you know? At the end of the day, we just want to love and be loved.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 我背负的伤痕，皆是我曾跌跌撞撞的印记，它们无声地诉说着过往的遗憾与成长。
quoteEn: I’ve got scars on my back from my own mistakes.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 获得掌声的极致，往往在生命谢幕之后。
quoteEn: The best way to get applause is to die.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 我骨子里，就带着那么一点点，天生的疏离。
quoteEn: Sometimes I’m a little bit of a loner, just by nature.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 我只是努力维系着内心的平衡，像个在无形钢索上行走的旅人，每一步都小心翼翼，却又不得不向前。
quoteEn: I just try to keep the balance. I’m a little bit of a tightrope walker.

author: 乔丹·彼得森
quoteCn: 请善待自己，如同你对珍视之人那般，肩负着温柔的责任。
quoteEn: Treat yourself like someone you are responsible for helping.

author: 约翰ny·凯许
quoteCn: 在我心底，那张未曾停歇的唱片，一直都在低声吟唱。
quoteEn: In my mind, I’m always making a record.

author: 乔丹·彼得森
quoteCn: 那些未曾说出口的，往往以更强大的姿态，在你的内心深处掀起波澜。
quoteEn: The things you do not say have power over you.

author: 乔丹·彼得森
quoteCn: 别去和此刻他人的光鲜比较，只和昨天的自己悄悄较量。
quoteEn: Compare yourself to who you were yesterday, not to who someone else is today.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 我所行之事，皆是灵魂深处的真实回响。唯一让我感到困扰的，是被世俗的标签所定义。
quoteEn: I am doing things that are true to me. The only thing I have a problem with is being labeled.

author: 约翰尼·德普
quoteCn: 你可以对那些不愿直视的现实闭上双眼，却无法对那些不愿触碰的情感，紧闭心门。
quoteEn: You can close your eyes to the things you do not want to see, but you cannot close your heart to the things you do not want to feel.

author: 荷西·里萨尔
quoteCn: 当那恰好的时刻降临，我的心，将是这世间最后一声沉寂的鼓点。
quoteEn: When the right time comes, my heart will be the last one to stop beating.

author: 约瑟夫·艾迪生
quoteCn: 我们皆同，因我们皆异。
quoteEn: We are all the same in that we are all different.

author: 约瑟夫·艾迪生
quoteCn: 没有什么比承认一份低劣的爱，更能让我们如此卑微，如此沉沦。那不是爱，那是自我贬低，是灵魂的枯萎。
quoteEn: There is nothing that makes us so abject and degrades us so much as the admission of a low quality of love.

author: 荷西·里萨尔
quoteCn: 我未曾亲眼见证你的到来，但我深信，你终将我的心血，昭告天下。
quoteEn: I die without seeing you, but I am sure you will show my work to the whole world.

author: 约瑟夫·艾迪生
quoteCn: 每个人都是一部深邃的卷宗，若你愿用心翻阅，便能读懂其中万千。
quoteEn: Every man is a volume if you know how to read him.

author: 约瑟夫·艾迪生
quoteCn: 无所事事，其实并无真正的欢愉；真正的乐趣，在于你明明有千头万绪，却选择此刻，什么都不做。
quoteEn: There is no pleasure in having nothing to do; the fun is having lots to do and not doing it.

author: 约瑟夫·艾迪生
quoteCn: 生命的要义，并非随波逐流，而是要守住内心的清明，不与世俗的疯狂同流合污。
quoteEn: The business of life is not to be on the side of the majority, but to escape finding oneself in the ranks of the insane.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 你心生畏惧，不敢踏足的幽深洞穴，恰恰珍藏着你毕生寻觅的宝藏。
quoteEn: The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 追随你内心深处那份纯粹的喜悦，你会发现，那些曾以为是高墙的阻碍，宇宙终将为你温柔开启一扇扇门。
quoteEn: Follow your bliss and the universe will open doors where there were only walls.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 神性之光，只为你一人闪耀，在你最深邃的内在。
quoteEn: The experience of the divine is personal.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 你的圣所，是你一次次与本真自我重逢的港湾。
quoteEn: Your sacred space is where you can find yourself over and over again.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 我们并非抵达终章，而是正值序幕。
quoteEn: We are not just at the end of the story, we are at the beginning.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 生命以痛吻我，我却报之以歌。那些看似最艰难的时刻，实则蕴藏着唤醒我们内在深层力量的契机。
quoteEn: Opportunities to find deeper powers within ourselves come when life seems most challenging.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 栖居于世，请贴近大地，感受泥土的芬芳与生命的律动；思索万物，请回归纯粹，让心湖澄澈，映照本真。
quoteEn: In dwelling, live close to the ground. In thinking, keep to the simple.

author: 约瑟夫·艾迪生
quoteCn: 勇气，并非是无畏地冲向险境，而是在深陷困厄之时，依然能心志坚定，不改其初。
quoteEn: Courage consists not in hazarding without fear; but being resolutely minded in a mischief.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 所谓英雄之旅，并非跋涉于山川湖海，而是灵魂深处的自我叩问与归途。
quoteEn: The hero journey is about the journey of the soul, not the physical journey.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 生命本无定数，意义由你而生。你，就是那意义的创造者。
quoteEn: Life is without meaning. You bring the meaning to it.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 你所信仰的生命故事，将指引你走向未来。
quoteEn: Your mythology is your future.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 你必须放下那些你曾紧握的规划，才能真正拥抱生命为你准备的惊喜。
quoteEn: You must give up the life you planned in order to have the life that is waiting for you.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 真正的问题在于，你是否能对你生命中的这场冒险，报以最热烈、最由衷的肯定。
quoteEn: The big question is whether you are going to be able to say a hearty yes to your adventure.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 生命的意义，在于一次次被更宏大的存在所击败，然后，在每一次的臣服中，找到新的自己。
quoteEn: The purpose of life is to be defeated by greater and greater things.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 婚姻中的付出，并非是对彼此的妥协，而是对这份联结本身的珍视与成全。
quoteEn: When you make the sacrifice in marriage, you're sacrificing not to each other but to unity in a relationship.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 灵魂自有其耳，聆听心智未及之音。
quoteEn: The soul has been given its own ears to hear things that the mind does not understand.

author: 约瑟夫·斯大林
quoteCn: 我谁都不信，甚至包括我自己。这份不信任，如同深渊，吞噬着所有可能的光亮。
quoteEn: I trust no one, not even myself.

author: 约瑟夫·斯大林
quoteCn: 一个生命的消逝是刻骨的悲剧，而千万生命的凋零，却往往被冰冷地归结为统计。
quoteEn: The death of one man is a tragedy; the death of millions is a statistic.

author: 乔伊斯·梅耶
quoteCn: 我或许还未抵达心之所向，但感恩，我已不再是昨日的自己！
quoteEn: I may not be where I want to be, but thank God I’m not where I used to be!

author: 乔伊斯·梅耶
quoteCn: 别让旁人的眼光，框定你存在的模样。
quoteEn: Don't let someone else's opinion of you become your reality.

author: 乔伊斯·梅耶
quoteCn: 神爱着你，不是因为你完美无缺，而是因为你就是你，全然被接纳。
quoteEn: God loves you unconditionally, as you are and not as you should be.

author: 乔伊斯·梅耶
quoteCn: 你的过往，绝非你未来的上限。
quoteEn: Your past is not your potential.

author: 乔伊斯·梅耶
quoteCn: 你可以选择承受蜕变的阵痛，也可以选择忍受停滞不前的钝痛。
quoteEn: You can suffer the pain of change or suffer remaining the way you are.

author: 乔伊斯·梅耶
quoteCn: 担忧，就像那把摇椅，看似忙碌，实则原地踏步，徒耗心力。
quoteEn: Worry is like a rocking chair; it gives you something to do but gets you nowhere.

author: 乔伊斯·梅耶
quoteCn: 宽恕，并非要你遗忘伤痛，而是选择放开那紧扼他人咽喉的手，也放过了自己。
quoteEn: Forgiveness is not about forgetting; it's about letting go of another person's throat.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 我常常迷失在自己的思绪里，那片无边无际的内心宇宙。
quoteEn: I tend to get lost in my thoughts.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 你的身影，仍在我房间的暗影里徘徊。
quoteEn: I still see your shadows in my room.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 我是一团乱麻，可我仍在拼尽全力。
quoteEn: I’m a mess, but I’m trying my best.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 痛楚终会消散，而那些刻骨铭心的记忆，却将与我们永生相伴。
quoteEn: The pain is temporary, the memories last forever.

author: 乔伊斯·梅耶
quoteCn: 允许自己，成为一个未完成的、正在生长的作品。
quoteEn: It's okay to be a work in progress.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 有时，我感觉自己像一个游荡在世间的魂魄，不被看见，不被触及。
quoteEn: Sometimes, it feels like I’m a ghost.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 那些盘踞在我脑海深处的，是挥之不去的梦魇。
quoteEn: All these demons in my head.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 我的梦境，像一部正在上演的电影，真实得让人心碎。
quoteEn: I have dreams like I’m living in a movie.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 我恐惧的，是我内心深处的那些暗流。
quoteEn: I’m afraid of what's inside my mind.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 我只是在活出我的生命，努力寻觅那份独属于我的共鸣。
quoteEn: I’m just living my life, trying to find my vibe.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 爱，并非万能解药。
quoteEn: Love is not always the answer.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 有些坎，你得亲自走一遭，才能真正跨过去。
quoteEn: You can’t get over it until you go through it.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 我把心事穿在袖子上，任由情绪裸露。
quoteEn: I wear my heart on my sleeve.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 我的心是一座牢笼，我被困在其中，无处可逃。
quoteEn: My mind is a prison, I’m trapped inside.

author: 朱斯·瓦尔顿
quoteCn: 死亡，并非终点，而是万物新生的序章。
quoteEn: Death is just the beginning.

author: 卡尔·马克思
quoteCn: 资本的洪流，最终也裹挟了资本家自己，让他们成为无形的奴隶。
quoteEn: Capitalism makes a slave of the capitalist himself.

author: 基努·里维斯
quoteCn: 我们都渴望被听见，被理解，被这世界温柔地回应。
quoteEn: We all want to be heard.

author: 基努·里维斯
quoteCn: 悲伤，如同一条冰冷的河流，悄无声息地淌过你的生命，留下彻骨的寒意与无尽的冲刷。
quoteEn: Grief is like a cold river that sweeps through your life.

author: 基努·里维斯
quoteCn: 渴望被爱，那是我们生命中最深沉的底色。
quoteEn: There’s something fundamental about wanting to be loved.

author: 肯德里克·拉马尔
quoteCn: 我并非生来就该承受苦难，我生来是为了超越。
quoteEn: I was not born to be a victim.

author: 凯文·盖茨
quoteCn: 我只是，不想再做从前的那个我了。
quoteEn: I just don't want to be the same person I was before.

author: 肯德里克·拉马尔
quoteCn: 我只是一个容器，承载着某种使命，与你我所见的表象全然不同。
quoteEn: I'm just a vessel, I'm not like you.

author: 基努·里维斯
quoteCn: 我其实，也一无所知啊。
quoteEn: I have no idea what I’m doing.

author: 肯德里克·拉马尔
quoteCn: 我本凡人，注定还会跌入红尘。
quoteEn: I’m a sinner, who’s probably gonna sin again.

author: 肯德里克·拉马尔
quoteCn: 我远不止你眼中所见，我的故事深藏不露。
quoteEn: It's a lot more to me than what you see.

author: 凯文·盖茨
quoteCn: 回望来时路，你已穿越万水千山。此刻的你，早已不是昨日的你。
quoteEn: Look at how far you’ve come. You’re not where you were.

author: 凯文·盖茨
quoteCn: 你的过往，并非你的囚笼，而是你蜕变的序章。
quoteEn: Your past doesn’t define you; it prepares you.

author: 凯文·盖茨
quoteCn: 别让世俗的喧嚣，定义了你灵魂的模样。
quoteEn: Don't let nobody tell you who you are.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 朋友，是灵魂的另一面镜子。
quoteEn: A friend is another self.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 当你悲伤时，请再次审视你的内心深处，你会发现，你此刻的泪水，正是为那些曾带给你无尽欢愉的过往而流。
quoteEn: When you are sorrowful look again in your heart, and you shall see that in truth you are weeping for that which has been your delight.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 美，非止于表象，更是心底深处那束温柔而坚韧的光。
quoteEn: Beauty is not in the face; beauty is a light in the heart.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 工作，是爱以可见之姿，降临人间。
quoteEn: Work is love made visible.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 世间至美，非目所能及，非手可触碰，唯心可深切感知。
quoteEn: The most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched, they must be felt with the heart.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 爱，唯有在别离的瞬间，方能洞悉其深邃。
quoteEn: Love knows not its own depth until the hour of separation.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 你的灵魂，往往是一片无声的战场，理智与判断的坚盾，正与激情和欲望的烈焰，在此刻永无止境地搏斗。
quoteEn: Your soul is oftentimes a battlefield, upon which your reason and your judgment wage war against your passion and your appetite.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 你们是那张弓，孩子们是离弦的箭，带着生命的渴望，射向远方。
quoteEn: You are the bows from which your children as living arrows are sent forth.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 在我灵魂的深处，藏着一份无尽的渴望，指向那永不可及的远方。
quoteEn: In the depths of my soul, I have a longing for that which I cannot find.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 友谊，是灵魂深处那份甜蜜的托付，而非世俗权衡的筹码。
quoteEn: Friendship is always a sweet responsibility, never an opportunity.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 你的孩子，并非真正属于你。他们是生命对自身渴望的化身，借你而来，却不为你所有。你可以给予他们爱，却无法禁锢他们的思想，因为他们有自己的灵魂，属于明天。
quoteEn: Your children are not your children. They are the sons and daughters of Life's longing for itself.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 在亲密无间中，也要留出呼吸的空隙，让天堂之风，轻柔地在你们之间起舞。
quoteEn: Let there be spaces in your togetherness, and let the winds of the heavens dance between you.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 那些曾让你遍体鳞伤的，正是光得以照进你生命裂隙的地方。
quoteEn: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 全然地活，活出完整的人性，彻底觉醒，这本身就是一场罕见而艰巨的修行。
quoteEn: To be fully alive, fully human, and completely awake is a rare and difficult achievement.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 你的生命，是神祇笔下最宏伟的杰作。而他，正穿梭于尘世的木架与支柱间，津津乐道地，低语着你的故事。
quoteEn: Your life is a mighty god's masterpiece, and he is gossiping about it amidst sawhorses and trestles.

author: 金泰亨
quoteCn: 音乐，是我灵魂深处最温柔的慰藉，如同老友般，无需言语，便能抚平所有波澜。
quoteEn: Music is like a friend that gives me comfort.

author: 金泰亨
quoteCn: 我必须，也只能永远忠于我心。
quoteEn: I think I always have to be honest with myself.

author: 哈利尔·吉布兰
quoteCn: 大地满载天堂的馈赠，每一丛灌木都燃烧着神性的光芒。
quoteEn: The earth is crammed with heaven, and every bush aflame with God.

author: 金泰亨
quoteCn: 愿我所有付出，都能温柔抵达所爱之人。
quoteEn: I hope that everything I do reaches the people I love.

author: 金泰亨
quoteCn: 洞悉你的本真，然后，试着去深爱那样的自己。
quoteEn: Know who you are and try to love it.

author: 金泰亨
quoteCn: 你的声音，轻柔地叩响我心扉深处。
quoteEn: Your voice touches my heart.

author: 金泰亨
quoteCn: 我终于，学会了好好爱自己。
quoteEn: I have come to love myself more.

author: 所罗门王
quoteCn: 美名远胜芬芳膏油，逝去之日或胜过初生之时。
quoteEn: A good name is better than good oil, and the day of death is better than the day of birth

author: 金·冯
quoteCn: 爱我与否，我自岿然。
quoteEn: Love me or hate me, I'm still gonna be me.

author: 金·冯
quoteCn: 我从不是谁的榜样，我只是，我本来的样子。
quoteEn: I ain't no role model, I'm just me.

author: 科比·布莱恩特
quoteCn: 勇气的真正动人之处，不是无所畏惧，而是明知心怀恐惧，却依然选择前行。
quoteEn: The beauty in being courageous is being scared.

author: 科达克·布莱克
quoteCn: 我只是想熬过去，活下来。
quoteEn: I'm just tryna make it out.

author: 科达克·布莱克
quoteCn: 街头，它从不曾回馈你的深情。
quoteEn: The streets don’t love you back.

author: 科达克·布莱克
quoteCn: 我已迫不及待，想把脑海中勾勒的那个自己，活成现实。
quoteEn: I can’t wait to live the life I imagined.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 我才不在乎你的想法，除非，那想法是关于我的。
quoteEn: I don't care what you think unless it is about me.

author: 科比·布莱恩特
quoteCn: 我对这项运动，爱之深，恨之切，它是我生命中无法割舍的纠缠。
quoteEn: I have a love/hate relationship with the game.

author: 科比·布莱恩特
quoteCn: 我甚至不确定，即便最终获胜，我是否能真正参透这胜利的深意。
quoteEn: I don't even know if I were to win, if I would even understand it.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 我多希望能更擅长与人相处啊。
quoteEn: I wish I could be more of a people person.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 宁愿因真我而受人厌弃，也不愿因伪装而被人爱戴。
quoteEn: I’d rather be hated for who I am than be loved for who I am not.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 我个人的结局如何已不重要，只要乐队能抵达彼岸，便已足够。
quoteEn: I really don't care if I do go, as long as the band makes it.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 我从未真正适应这世界，我只是，一团混乱。
quoteEn: I’m not well-adjusted. I’m a mess.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 我所有的朋友都已逝去。
quoteEn: All of my friends are dead.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 我如此快乐，因为今日我寻回了我的挚友，他们栖居于我的思想深处。
quoteEn: I’m so happy because today I found my friends, they’re in my head.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 为你欢欣，而我，已无力再展笑颜。
quoteEn: I'm really happy for you, but I can't be happy anymore.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 最深重的罪过，莫过于对自我真实性的背叛。
quoteEn: The worst crime is faking it.

author: 库特·冯内古特
quoteCn: 万物皆美，不染纤尘。
quoteEn: Everything was beautiful and nothing hurt.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 人群的喧嚣，总让我感到无所适从。
quoteEn: I have a hard time in crowds.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 我只想回家，回到那个能让我卸下一切伪装的港湾。
quoteEn: The only thing I want is to be at home.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 我想，我骨子里更像个懦夫，而非其他。
quoteEn: I think I’m more of a coward than anything.

author: 库特·冯内古特
quoteCn: 我们假装成为什么，最终就会成为什么。所以，请务必小心你所扮演的那个自己。
quoteEn: We are what we pretend to be, so we must be careful about what we pretend to be.

author: 库特·冯内古特
quoteCn: 我们能做的最像人、最本真的事，就是允许自己去体验和成为一个人。
quoteEn: The most human thing any of us can do is to be human.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 真相是，我从未觉得自己值得被爱。
quoteEn: The truth is that I am not worth it.

author: 库特·冯内古特
quoteCn: 我告诉你，我们来这世间，就是为了尽情地虚度光阴，别让任何人告诉你，这有什么不对。
quoteEn: I tell you, we are here on Earth to fart around, and don't let anybody tell you any different.

author: 库特·冯内古特
quoteCn: 我无法言明我所坚信的，但我能清晰地告诉你，我所摒弃的。
quoteEn: I can’t tell you what I believe, but I can tell you what I don’t believe.

author: 库特·冯内古特
quoteCn: 我们降临人世，不过是来人间晃荡一遭。别让任何人，用任何方式，否定你这份自在。
quoteEn: We are all here on Earth to fart around. Don’t let anybody tell you any different.

author: 库尔特·科本
quoteCn: 音乐，如同信仰。你所倾注的，便是它的全部意义。
quoteEn: Music is like religion. It’s whatever you believe in.

author: 库特·冯内古特
quoteCn: 笑吧，尽管生活荒诞。它是唯一能将我从失序边缘拉回的锚点。
quoteEn: Laughing helps. It is the only thing that keeps me sane.

author: 女神卡卡
quoteCn: 你生来如此，无需改变，这便是你最本真的模样。
quoteEn: You are born this way.

author: 女神卡卡
quoteCn: 我已身处深渊边缘，看我如何纵身跃入。
quoteEn: I’m off the deep end, watch as I dive in.

author: 女神卡卡
quoteCn: 我即我之圣殿，我亦我之传奇。
quoteEn: I’m my own sanctuary and I can be my own story.

author: 女神卡卡
quoteCn: 我想成为那片海，轻柔地荡漾，自由地流淌。
quoteEn: I want to be like the ocean, rippling and flowing.

author: 女神卡卡
quoteCn: 我，即我此生最杰出的艺术品。
quoteEn: I am my own work of art.

author: 老子
quoteCn: 洞悉他人者，谓之智；洞悉自我者，方为明。征服他人者，或显其力；征服自我者，方得其强。
quoteEn: He who knows others is wise; he who knows himself is enlightened. He who conquers others has strength; he who conquers himself is strong.

author: 库特·冯内古特
quoteCn: 若此非幸，何谓幸福？
quoteEn: If this isn't nice, I don't know what is.

author: 老子
quoteCn: 至高的善意，如同流水。它滋养万物，却从不争夺，只是温柔地存在。
quoteEn: The highest good is like water. Water benefits all things and does not compete.

author: 老子
quoteCn: 灾祸是福报的伏笔，福报也潜藏着灾祸的影子。世事无常，祸福相依，不必执着于一时得失。
quoteEn: Disaster is the source of fortune; fortune is hidden in disaster.

author: 老子
quoteCn: 以无为之姿，行无事之境，品无味之真。让一切自然发生，不强求，不执着，在空无中体味生命的本真。
quoteEn: Act without action, do nothing, taste without taste.

author: 老子
quoteCn: 栽树者，深培其根；修德者，静养其心。
quoteEn: Those who plant trees must nurture their roots; those who cultivate virtue must nourish their hearts.

author: 勒布朗·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 当我停止创造，我便不再完整。那一天，我将失去作为‘人’的灵魂。
quoteEn: The day I stop being creative is the day I stop being a person.

author: 老子
quoteCn: 天地恒久，因其不为己生，故能长存。这是一种无私的智慧，提醒我们，真正的永恒，不在于索取，而在于放下自我，融入更大的存在。
quoteEn: The heavens and the earth endure forever; the reason the heavens and the earth can endure forever is that they do not exist for themselves, therefore they can live long.

author: 女神卡卡
quoteCn: 我并非异类，我只是一个，和你我一样，会痛会爱的凡人。
quoteEn: I’m not a monster. I’m just a human being.

author: 勒布朗·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 我想，在一天落幕时，真正重要的，唯有你如何看待，你究竟是何模样。
quoteEn: I think, at the end of the day, the only thing that matters is how you feel about who you are.

author: 女神卡卡
quoteCn: 在这瞬息万变的潮流洪流中，我愿成为那份永恒的经典，不随波逐流，只为自我而存在。
quoteEn: In a world full of trends, I want to remain a classic.

author: 老子
quoteCn: 至柔之处，蕴藏至刚之力；至刚之境，亦流淌至柔之情。
quoteEn: In great softness, there is great firmness; in great firmness, there is great softness.

author: 莱米
quoteCn: 生来注定失去，却为赢得而活。
quoteEn: Born to lose, live to win.

author: 莱米
quoteCn: 世事于我，皆如戏谑。
quoteEn: Everything is a joke to me.

author: 莱米
quoteCn: 若你已无法对自己一笑置之，那生命的光彩或许也已黯淡。
quoteEn: If you can’t laugh at yourself, you might as well be dead.

author: 女神卡卡
quoteCn: 我只是在努力，寻回那个本真的自己。
quoteEn: I’m just trying to find myself.

author: 老子
quoteCn: 真正的大才，往往需要时间沉淀方能显露锋芒；而最深沉、最动人的声音，却常常隐匿于无形，不被世人轻易察觉。
quoteEn: Great talents mature late; the greatest sound is seldom heard.

author: 莱米
quoteCn: 世人皆不解，而我以此为傲。
quoteEn: A lot of people don’t get it, and I’m proud of that.

author: 莱米
quoteCn: 我们无需被理解，只需存在。
quoteEn: We don’t need to be understood.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 你眼中所见之人，即是你心中所待之客。
quoteEn: The way you see people is the way you treat them.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 我们需要彼此，才能成为完整的自己。
quoteEn: We need others to be complete.

author: 莱米
quoteCn: 我此生，只为摇滚而生。
quoteEn: I just want to play rock and roll.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 当你真正懂得去爱，你便挣脱了所有束缚，获得了灵魂的自由。
quoteEn: Once a person learns to love, they are free.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 我们降临此世，并非为了被世俗接纳，而是为了，去爱，去深爱彼此。
quoteEn: We are not put on this earth to be accepted; we are put here to love one another.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 你永远拥有重新选择的自由，去描绘一个截然不同的未来，或书写一个全新的故事篇章。
quoteEn: You are always free to change your mind and choose a different future, or a different story.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 我们总以为那些微不足道的瞬间——一个轻柔的触碰，一抹会心的微笑，一句不经意的善语，一次全神贯注的倾听，一句发自肺腑的赞美，或那最细微的关怀举动——它们的力量微不足道。殊不知，正是这些，拥有颠覆生命轨迹的潜能。
quoteEn: Too often we underestimate the power of a touch, a smile, a kind word, a listening ear, an honest compliment, or the smallest act of caring, all of which have the potential to turn a life around.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 死亡，是万物归一的终章，抚平所有尘世的喧嚣与不公。
quoteEn: Death is the great equalizer.

author: 莱米
quoteCn: 我从不在意你如何评判我，因为我的世界里，从未有过你的身影。
quoteEn: I don’t care what you think about me. I don’t think about you at all.

author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
quoteCn: 幸福并非在于你拥有了什么，而在于你如何存在。
quoteEn: Happiness is not in having, but in being.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 爱，是永恒的敞开。当你试图紧握它时，最终怀抱的，只有你自己。
quoteEn: Love is always open arms. If you close your arms about love, you will find that you are left holding only yourself.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 万物皆有裂痕，那是光得以透入的地方。
quoteEn: The crack in everything is where the light gets in.

author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
quoteCn: 若生命中无爱同行，我们便不曾真正活过。
quoteEn: One cannot truly live if one does not live with love.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 你必须告别安逸的城池，踏入直觉的旷野。
quoteEn: You have to leave the city of your comfort and go into the wilderness of your intuition.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 与我共舞，直至爱之尽头。
quoteEn: Dance me to the end of love.

author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
quoteCn: 命运洪流，冲垮理性堤坝。
quoteEn: Fate is stronger than reason.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 未来并非关乎将至的际遇，而是我们如何被塑造成长。
quoteEn: The future is not so much about what will happen as it is about what we will become.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 若你不能化作海洋，便日日为浪潮所困。
quoteEn: If you don't become the ocean, you'll be seasick every day.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 我曾尝试成为一名艺术家，也曾直面我所有的溃败。
quoteEn: I have tried to be an artist. And I've stood up to my own failures.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 诗歌，不过是你活过的证明。如果你的生命曾炽热燃烧，那诗歌，便是那片余温尚存的灰烬。
quoteEn: Poetry is just the evidence of life. If your life is burning well, poetry is just the ash.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 万物皆有裂隙，那是光得以透入的所在。
quoteEn: There is a crack in everything. That's how the light gets in.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 爱并非凯旋的颂歌，它是一曲冰冷而破碎的哈利路亚。
quoteEn: Love is not a victory march. It's a cold and it's a broken hallelujah.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 世间万物，皆非尽善尽美。这世界亦然，残缺却真实地存在着。而它，正以其不完美之姿，等待你我，去细细品味，去尽情拥抱。
quoteEn: Nothing is perfect. The world is not perfect. But it’s there to be enjoyed.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 身为诗人，便是以灵魂为笔，描摹这世间的甘美与可怖，不偏不倚，尽收眼底。
quoteEn: To be a poet is to be a witness to sweetness and horror.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 我们如此完美，满载光芒、爱意与甜美，以至于我们唯一的探寻，便是那深藏的阴影。
quoteEn: We are so perfect, so full of light and love and sweetness, that we can only explore our darkness.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 一场无声的战役，正悄然在你灵魂深处打响。
quoteEn: There is a war going on for your soul.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 你心之所向，便是你眼中的世界。
quoteEn: What is in the heart is in the world.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 我们是否真正懂得什么，我已无从知晓。我只明白，这世间的万般，都远超我们想象的边界。
quoteEn: I don’t know if we know anything about anything. I just know that it’s difficult to imagine.

author: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇
quoteCn: 人这一生，最深的迷局，往往是自己深信不疑的执念。
quoteEn: The greatest deception men suffer is from their own opinions.

author: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇
quoteCn: 当白昼被丰盈填满，夜晚的梦境便会安然降临。
quoteEn: A well-spent day brings happy sleep.

author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
quoteCn: 我已窥见未来，兄弟：那是一场谋杀。
quoteEn: I've seen the future, brother: it is murder.

author: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇
quoteCn: 如同尽兴的一天带来安稳的睡梦，善用此生，亦能安然归去。
quoteEn: As a well-spent day brings happy sleep, so life well used brings happy death.

author: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇
quoteCn: 经验本身无过，错的是我们一厢情愿的期待，妄图从它那里索取它从未许诺的答案。
quoteEn: Experience does not err. Only your judgments err by expecting from her what she cannot give.

author: 莱斯·布朗
quoteCn: 别人的眼光，不必成为你生命的定格。
quoteEn: Other people's opinion of you does not have to become your reality.

author: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇
quoteCn: 画者的心，当如水，随物赋形，澄澈无碍。
quoteEn: The mind of the painter should be like water, simply flowing.

author: 莱斯·布朗
quoteCn: 我们太多人，不是在追逐梦想，而是在被恐惧追逐。
quoteEn: Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.

author: 莱斯·布朗
quoteCn: 明日的万丈光芒，唯有今日你口中的“但是”能将其遮蔽。
quoteEn: The only limits to the possibilities in your life tomorrow are the buts you use today.

author: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿
quoteCn: 你必须准备好承受那份孤独，因为并非所有人都懂得你心中的那片星辰大海。
quoteEn: You have to be prepared to be lonely, but not everyone understands your dream.

author: 小宝宝
quoteCn: 我所求，不过是让家人因我而荣。
quoteEn: I just want to make my family proud.

author: 小宝宝
quoteCn: 他们不懂我这身疲惫，不懂我一路的跋涉。
quoteEn: They don’t understand the grind.

author: 利尔·德克
quoteCn: 世人或憎恶你，或评判你，或动摇你，最终将你击溃。但请记住，你的价值，从不由他人定义。
quoteEn: People will hate you, rate you, shake you, and break you.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 我并非无瑕，我只是一个，活生生的人。
quoteEn: I’m not a perfect person, I’m just a human being.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 爱，是唯一能让我坚持下去的理由。
quoteEn: Love is the only thing that keeps me going.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 我所经历的，是许多人内心深处的共鸣。
quoteEn: The things I’m going through, people can relate to.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 我将心掏出，无惧展露它的赤裸与脆弱。
quoteEn: I put my heart out and I’m not afraid to show it.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 我不想成为任何人的榜样，只想做我自己，哪怕这不完美。
quoteEn: I don’t want to be a role model.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 音乐是我的港湾，它让我得以喘息，安放那些无处可去的灵魂碎片。
quoteEn: Music is my outlet; it helps me cope.

author: 利尔·德克
quoteCn: 你所拥有的一切，都可能在一夜之间化为乌有。
quoteEn: You can lose everything you have overnight.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 死亡，是我宿命的终点，无法挣脱的宿命。
quoteEn: Death is something I can’t escape.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 我渴望生命如流星般绚烂，哪怕只是一瞬，也要在最盛放时悄然陨落。
quoteEn: I want to live fast, die young.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 我只是想，轻轻触碰那些心弦。
quoteEn: I just want to touch people’s hearts.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 幸福，不过是唇齿间的一个音节，它从未真正降临。
quoteEn: Happiness is just a word; it’s not real.

author: 小维恩
quoteCn: 我被困在自己的心牢里，挣扎着，却也无处可逃。
quoteEn: I'm a prisoner of my own mind.

author: 小辣椒
quoteCn: 我的音乐，是为那些被世界遗忘、格格不入的灵魂而作。
quoteEn: My music is for the outcasts and the misfits.

author: 小维恩
quoteCn: 我从不追逐，若你执意离去，我便温柔放手。
quoteEn: I don’t chase after anyone, if you wanna walk out of my life, then I’ll let you.

author: 小维恩
quoteCn: 我本该早已消逝，此刻，我的存在本身就是一场奇迹。
quoteEn: I should be dead. I shouldn't even be here right now.

author: 小维恩
quoteCn: 人生如一片无垠沙滩，而我，不过是其中一个，随心所欲地，玩着沙子。
quoteEn: Life is a beach, and I’m just playing in the sand.

author: 林纳斯·托瓦兹
quoteCn: 我自认是个糟糕的程序员，或许正因我从未真正满足。
quoteEn: I think I’m a terrible programmer, but maybe that’s because I’m never really satisfied.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 你可以不带爱意地给予，但爱，从不吝啬付出。
quoteEn: You can give without loving, but you cannot love without giving.

author: 里欧·布斯卡利亚
quoteCn: 正是那些微小的闪光，汇聚成生命磅礴的意义。
quoteEn: It’s the little things that make life big.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 生命的宏大旨趣，在于真切地感受，在于确凿地感知到自己的存在。
quoteEn: The great object of life is sensation – to feel that we exist.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 她步履轻盈，美如无垠夜空，清澈无云，繁星点点。
quoteEn: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies;

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 若不以笔墨倾泻思绪，我恐将陷入疯狂的深渊。
quoteEn: If I don’t write to empty my mind, I go mad.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 我非凡尘俗子，亦非高高在上之神明。
quoteEn: I am not a man, and I am not a god.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 心的羁绊，远胜过权力的束缚。
quoteEn: The bonds of affection are stronger than the bonds of command.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 真相，总是比我们编织的故事，更显诡谲与陌生。
quoteEn: Truth is always strange; stranger than fiction.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 在无人涉足的林间，心生欢愉；在寂寥无人的海岸，灵魂狂喜。
quoteEn: There is pleasure in the pathless woods, there is rapture in the lonely shore.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 爱，总能找到它的路，哪怕是在群狼都望而却步的荒野。它不是征服，是穿越，是生命最深处的温柔与勇气。
quoteEn: Love will find a way through paths where wolves fear to prey.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 心若不愿屈就，终将碎裂。
quoteEn: The heart will break if it will not bend.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 身处孤独，我们才最不孤独。
quoteEn: In solitude, where we are least alone.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 男人的爱，是他生命中一道风景，可有可无；女人的爱，却是她生命赖以存在的全部意义。
quoteEn: Man's love is of man's life a thing apart, 'tis woman's whole existence.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 纵使爱过，终将失去，也胜过从未敞开心扉，感受爱意。
quoteEn: 'Tis better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 我即牧者，我亦羊群，我只追随我心。
quoteEn: I am my own shepherd; I follow myself.

author: 拜伦
quoteCn: 世间万般智慧的终点，竟是空无、虚妄与傲慢。
quoteEn: What is the end of all the world’s wisdom? Emptiness, vanity, and pride.

author: 卢·霍尔茨
quoteCn: 压垮你的，从来不是生活的重负，而是你背负它的姿态。
quoteEn: It’s not the load that breaks you down, it’s the way you carry it.

author: 塞涅卡
quoteCn: 没有书籍的生命，如同枯萎的死亡。
quoteEn: Life without books is death.

author: 塞涅卡
quoteCn: 幸福，是能坦然面对生命终章的从容。
quoteEn: Beatus is he who can prepare himself for his end.

author: 卢·霍尔茨
quoteCn: 世间万事，看似轻巧，实则不易；看似艰巨，实则可为。这便是生活的辩证，也是我们内心的写照。
quoteEn: Nothing is as easy as it looks, and nothing is as hard as it seems.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 音乐，是情感最凝练的速写，是灵魂深处无言的共鸣。
quoteEn: Music is the shorthand of emotion.

author: 塞涅卡
quoteCn: 智者啊，你所执着的痛楚，究竟为何物？
quoteEn: What is it, then, wise man, that you accept for pain?

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 我的情感，只向音乐倾诉。
quoteEn: I tell my emotions to my music.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 艺术啊，谁能真正洞悉她的奥秘？这位伟大的女神，我们又能向谁寻求指引，以触及她的灵魂深处？
quoteEn: Art! Who comprehends her? With whom can one consult concerning this great goddess?

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 错音，不过是乐谱上的一个意外；而没有灵魂的演奏，才是对音乐最深的辜负。
quoteEn: To play a wrong note is insignificant; to play without passion is inexcusable.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 音乐的馈赠，深藏于我们的心魂深处。
quoteEn: The gift of music is in the heart and spirit.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 你生而为何，是命运的偶然；我成为何人，是我自己的选择与塑造。
quoteEn: What you are, you are by accident of birth; what I am, I am by myself.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 音乐并非仅仅是音符的堆叠，它更深藏于音符之间那片无声的留白里，那是灵魂共鸣的呼吸。
quoteEn: The music is not in the notes, but in the silence between.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 生命太短，不该为那些不和谐的音符停留。
quoteEn: Life is too short for the wrong notes.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 能真正征服一切的，唯有那份至深至纯的爱意。
quoteEn: The conqueror of the world must be a great love.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 你必须能从自己的创作中寻得喜悦，否则，一切都将失去它本来的意义。
quoteEn: One must also be able to take delight in one's own works; otherwise, they are not worth it!

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 我无法以任何其他方式书写，唯有心之所向。
quoteEn: I cannot write in any other way than from the heart.

author: 麦克·米勒
quoteCn: 我们都在这世间跌跌撞撞，只为寻得一方安身立命的归途。
quoteEn: We’re all just trying to find our way.

author: 麦克·米勒
quoteCn: 你得去拥抱那些不完美，它们才是你生命中最真实的印记。
quoteEn: You gotta embrace the imperfections.

author: 麦克·米勒
quoteCn: 人生，不过是一场又一场，试图厘清思绪的旅程。
quoteEn: Life is just a series of trying to make up your mind.

author: 麦克·米勒
quoteCn: 懂得越多，越发觉自己的无知。这并非退步，而是智慧的开端，是谦卑与探索的邀请。
quoteEn: The more you know, the less you know.

author: 麦克·米勒
quoteCn: 那些无法滋养你、让你日益枯萎的事物，是时候转身离开了。
quoteEn: You have to walk away from the things that don’t make you strong.

author: 麦克·米勒
quoteCn: 我将我的心与魂，尽数倾注于我的音乐。
quoteEn: I pour my heart and soul into my music.

author: 麦克·米勒
quoteCn: 夜幕降临，尘埃落定，最终沉淀下来的，唯有爱意。
quoteEn: At the end of the day, it's all love.

author: 麦德琳·连格尔
quoteCn: 若你渴望成为书写者，便须甘愿融入那一片深邃的静默。
quoteEn: If you want to be a writer, you must be willing to be part of the silence.

author: 麦德琳·连格尔
quoteCn: 一个好故事的馈赠，在于它能帮助我们梳理生命的脉络，寻得意义。
quoteEn: The gift of a good story is that it helps us make sense of our lives.

author: 麦德琳·连格尔
quoteCn: 我们都在被时光雕琢，每个人都是一幅未完待续的画卷。
quoteEn: We are all being perfected. Each one of us is a work in progress.

author: 麦德琳·连格尔
quoteCn: 若想留下希望的遗产，我们便要像河流般思考，川流不息，滋养万物。
quoteEn: We must start thinking like a river if we are to leave a legacy of hope.

author: 麦德琳·连格尔
quoteCn: 万物皆有时序，世间万象皆有其节律。不必强求，无需焦虑，只需顺应。
quoteEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.

author: 麦德琳·连格尔
quoteCn: 你必须愿意，为那虚无中的喜悦而欢欣。
quoteEn: You have to be willing to get happy about nothing.

author: 麦克·米勒
quoteCn: 当你身处高空，俯瞰众生，要如何才能不忘来时的路，不失本心？
quoteEn: It’s hard to stay grounded when you’re flying.

author: 梅·韦斯特
quoteCn: 我从未以爱自己的方式，去爱过另一个人。
quoteEn: I never loved another person the way I loved myself.

author: 梅·韦斯特
quoteCn: 我曾是纯真如雪，但命运之流将我带向远方。
quoteEn: I used to be Snow White, but I drifted.

author: 梅·韦斯特
quoteCn: 女人一旦坠入爱河，便无法再保持理智。若能理智，又怎会深陷其中？
quoteEn: A woman in love can't be reasonable or she would never be in love.

author: 梅·韦斯特
quoteCn: 我不过是想讨杯咖啡，他们却总要深究其言外之意。
quoteEn: If I asked for a cup of coffee, someone would search for the double meaning.

author: 梅·韦斯特
quoteCn: 好东西，多一点，又何妨？甚至，可以更精彩。
quoteEn: Too much of a good thing can be wonderful.

author: 梅·韦斯特
quoteCn: 我唯一的遗憾，是那些未曾说出口的话语。
quoteEn: The only thing I would be sad about is if I never had the chance to say it.

author: 麦德琳·连格尔
quoteCn: 爱，是场温柔的修行，始于对自我的珍视与接纳。
quoteEn: The only way to love is to love oneself.

author: 玛吉·史密斯
quoteCn: 那些无法言喻的，才是真正触动我心弦的。
quoteEn: The only things that seem to interest me are the things that can’t be explained.

author: 梅·韦斯特
quoteCn: 我遇到的每个男人都想保护我，可我就是不明白，到底要保护我免受什么呢？这世间，我最不需要的，或许就是被保护。
quoteEn: Every man I meet wants to protect me. I can’t figure out what from.

author: 玛吉·史密斯
quoteCn: 年龄，不过是岁月留下的印记。重要的不是你度过了多少春秋，而是你如何优雅地，或坦然地，与时光共舞。
quoteEn: Age is just a number. It’s not how old you are; it’s how you are old.

author: 玛吉·史密斯
quoteCn: 岁月流转，才懂得万物皆有其温柔与奇迹，愈发珍视这世间的美好。
quoteEn: It’s true that the older you get, the more you realize how wonderful everything is.

author: 甘地
quoteCn: 若无犯错的余地，自由便失去了其本真与价值。
quoteEn: Freedom is not worth having if it does not include the freedom to make mistakes.

author: 甘地
quoteCn: 以温柔之姿，亦可撼动天地。
quoteEn: In a gentle way, you can shake the world.

author: 甘地
quoteCn: 若服务中无喜悦，施者受者皆空。
quoteEn: Service which is rendered without joy helps neither the servant nor the served.

author: 甘地
quoteCn: 真正的敌人是恐惧。我们误以为那是仇恨，可剥开表象，它始终是那份深藏的恐惧。
quoteEn: The enemy is fear. We think it is hate; but, it is fear.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 我来自那片土地，来自那些曾为生命深情歌唱的人们。
quoteEn: I am from there, from those who sang for life.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 爱，即是生命本身。
quoteEn: Love is a form of life.

author: 甘地
quoteCn: 活出你生命的极致，仿佛明天即是终点；学习你灵魂的深度，仿佛时间永无止境。
quoteEn: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.

author: 甘地
quoteCn: 你所思所想，即是你之所是。心念流转间，塑就你我。
quoteEn: A man is but the product of his thoughts. What he thinks, he becomes.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 我笔下流淌的，并非身外之物，而是我灵魂深处的潮汐。
quoteEn: I don't write about what is outside of me, I write about what is inside of me.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 无论我们如何争执，在爱里，我们总能找到彼此的共鸣。
quoteEn: Whenever we disagree on something, we agree on love.

author: 甘地
quoteCn: 真正的伟大，并非在于我们能如何翻天覆地改造世界，而在于我们能否一次次，温柔而坚定地重塑自我。
quoteEn: Our greatness lies not so much in being able to remake the world, as in being able to remake ourselves.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 如果痛楚无言，就让它自己低语吧。
quoteEn: If you can't express the pain, let it speak.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 生命中万物皆有轮回，唯独爱，是那永不复刻的奇迹。
quoteEn: Everything in life repeats, except love.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 我落笔，只为卸下这身心的沉重。
quoteEn: I write to free myself from my weight.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 你是我此生，再也无法触及的梦境。
quoteEn: You are the dream I could never live.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 心中，万千故土皆安居。
quoteEn: In the heart, all homelands live.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 我为自己设下重重疑问，却始终寻不见答案的踪迹。
quoteEn: I have created questions for myself, and I did not find answers to them.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 没有爱的生命，如同一次漫长的死亡。
quoteEn: Life without love is like death.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 再予我一道新伤吧，我便能为你，将那旧爱，字字泣血地书写。
quoteEn: Give me a new wound, so I can write you an old love.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 我的故事未竟，生命便不会终结。
quoteEn: I will not die before I tell my story.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 笔墨流淌之处，亦是我心淌血之时。
quoteEn: The more I write, the more I hurt myself.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 每个人的心底，都藏着一片故土。
quoteEn: There is a homeland in the heart of every human being.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 我们所失去的，才是真正的天堂。
quoteEn: The true paradises are the ones we have lost.

author: 马哈穆德·达尔维什
quoteCn: 笔尖流淌，生命归尘。一笔一划是存在的证明，一抔黄土是万物的终点。
quoteEn: A hand flows on paper, and a hand in the ground.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 艺术并非感官的欢愉，而是灵魂深处的映照与回响。
quoteEn: Art is not a pleasure, but a reflection.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 记忆，总是比现实更擅长编织梦境。
quoteEn: Memory is often more beautiful than reality.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 幸福，往往是爱不期而至的馈赠。
quoteEn: Happiness is often a side effect of love.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 生命的光，总在回忆深处闪耀。
quoteEn: It is through memories that life is illuminated.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 我们皆由易碎的材质织就。
quoteEn: We are all made of fabric that tears.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 我们穷尽一生追寻的，并非逝去的时光本身，而是记忆深处那份不曾消散的温度与痕迹。
quoteEn: The search for lost time is, indeed, an act of memory.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 记忆，是懂得如何遗忘的艺术。
quoteEn: Memory is the art of knowing how to forget.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 时光荏苒，唯记忆永驻心间。
quoteEn: Time passes, but memory remains.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 别再等了，别等到快乐才开始生活。生活，此刻就开始。
quoteEn: You should not wait to be happy to start living.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 人真正该恐惧的，并非死亡的终结，而是从未真正开始，活出生命的本真。
quoteEn: It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear never beginning to live.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 我们终其一生，都在他人的眼中寻找自我，映照出灵魂深处的轮廓。
quoteEn: We need others to understand ourselves.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 你，不过是一缕微渺的灵魂，背负着这具终将腐朽的皮囊。
quoteEn: You are a little soul carrying around a corpse.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 那些以为早已消逝的感受，有时会以记忆的姿态，悄然归来。
quoteEn: Lost sensations sometimes regain memory.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 真正的人生，是那最终被我们发现并清晰照亮的人生，也唯有如此，才算得上是全然活过。
quoteEn: The true life, the life finally discovered and clarified, the only life therefore fully lived.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 最好的回击，不是以牙还牙，而是活成那个伤害你的人永远无法企及的模样。
quoteEn: The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 你的灵魂，终将被你所思所想浸染成色。那些无声的念头，正悄然描绘着你内在世界的模样。
quoteEn: The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 当一个人不再执着于他人的目光，不再渴求被理解或被在意，他便赢得了生命中多少宝贵的自由与时间啊。
quoteEn: How much time he gains who does not look to see whether others will care.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 孤独，是灵魂得以自由舒展的旷野。
quoteEn: Solitude is a space of freedom.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 向内看。那善的泉眼，就在你心底深处，只要你愿意持续挖掘，它便会永不枯竭地涌流，滋养你的生命。
quoteEn: Look within. Within is the fountain of good, and it will ever bubble up, if you will ever dig.

author: 马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗
quoteCn: 若心有所属，一园一书，足矣慰平生。
quoteEn: If you have a garden and a library, you have everything you need.

author: 马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗
quoteCn: 逝者的生命，在生者的记忆中永恒。
quoteEn: The life of the dead is placed in the memory of the living.

author: 马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗
quoteCn: 我们如思绪般繁盛，如思绪般万象。每一念，皆塑就一个我。
quoteEn: We are as numerous and as various as our thoughts.

author: 玛格丽特·米德
quoteCn: 若想文化丰饶，我们必须允许自己，随心所欲，不被系泊。
quoteEn: If we are to achieve a rich culture, we must allow ourselves to be unmoored.

author: 玛格丽特·米德
quoteCn: 那些深埋心底的羞耻，往往是生命中最动人的篇章。
quoteEn: What people are ashamed of usually makes a good story.

author: 玛格丽特·米德
quoteCn: 请永远记得，你生而独特，与众不同。一如这世间，每个人都如此。
quoteEn: Always remember that you are absolutely unique. Just like everyone else.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 将你生命中的每一个行动，都视作你人生的最后一幕。如此，你将活出每一个瞬间的极致与无悔。
quoteEn: Do every act of your life as though it were the very last act of your life.

author: 马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗
quoteCn: 沉默，是对话中那门深邃而动人的艺术。
quoteEn: Silence is one of the great arts of conversation.

author: 玛格丽特·米德
